title: Consulting Architect - Search
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
We are seeking an exceptional and highly experienced
**Consulting Architect**
to join our Global Capability Center. This senior role is critical to the success of our global customers, focusing on the strategic design and hands-on implementation of the Elastic Stack with focus on Search AI.
  
  
You will serve as a trusted technical architect and consultant, working with complex enterprise environments to translate business challenges into robust, scalable, and value-driven Elastic solutions. The role requires a blend of deep technical expertise, senior-level consulting acumen, and the ability to work effectively across time zones, with both remote support and required on-site client engagement.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**
As a member of our professional services team you will deliver Elastic solutions and Elastic stack expertise to drive customer business value from our products. Work with clients to facilitate strategy, roadmap, design, and sizing in workshops. You will apply your soft skills to advocate for your customers, build relationships and exhibit strong communications skills. Comfortability working remotely or on-site in a highly distributed team. Your activities will include end-to-end delivery of ground-breaking Elastic projects to our customers, as well as development of proof-of-concepts that highlight the value of the Elastic Stack and its solutions. Other topics will include Elastic solutions adaption and acceleration along with data modeling, query development and optimization, cluster tuning and scaling with a focus on fast search and analytics at scale.
  
  
Daily tasks include driving and handling the objectives, requirements gathering, project tasks, project status, dependencies, and timelines, to ensure engagements are delivered optimally and on time while meeting and exceeding the customer objectives. Your goal is to make your customers love Elastic and achieve amazing value from the platform!
  
  
Work across teams with engineering, product management, and support teams to identify feature improvements, extensions, and product defects. Facilitate feedback from the field back to the product. Engage with the Elastic Sales team to scope opportunities while assessing technical risks, questions, or concerns. Be a mentor to your team members, while also learning from them to accelerate your skills
  
  
**What You Bring:**
**Essential Qualifications**

* Elastic Certification: Required – Active Elastic Certified Engineer certification is mandatory.
* Experience: Minimum of 7+ years as a Consulting Architect, Senior Technical Consultant, or equivalent senior IT functional role.
* Consulting History: A strong history of working as a Consultant delivering professional services engagements in complex enterprise environments.
* Domain Expertise: Proven experience in deploying solutions using Elastic core domain: Enterprise Search.
* Experience in solving complex technical search problems in terms of relevancy, scaling, performance fine-tuning, building a platform to handle high query throughputs and indexing throughput, benchmarking clusters to achieve optimal performance.
* Experience in leading and delivering Enterprise Search projects at both the architectural and program level.
* Experience in GenAI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector embeddings.
* Deep understanding of distributed architecture including application, database and systems.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with on-prem systems and/or major public/private cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Technical Depth: Hands-on experience in Linux, networking, security, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure automation.
* Programming/Scripting: Experience utilizing programming or scripting languages in a corporate environment (e.g., Python, Javascript, Go).
* Communication: Exceptional customer advocacy, relationship-building, and soft skills including whiteboarding and driving architectural conversations. Proven ability to lead and articulate technical solutions to stakeholders.
* Travel: Ability and willingness to travel to client sites periodically as required for project success (up to 20%)
* Work Style: Comfortable working effectively in a highly distributed and remote team, spanning multiple global time zones.
* BS or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.

**Bonus Points:**

* Familiarity/Experience in implementing similar products in Search Domain (Solr, Algolia, Open Search)
* Any cloud service provider's - Gen AI certification.
* Additional Elastic Certifications (e.g., Elastic Certified Analyst, Specializations) and/or specialization in machine learning, data analytics.

title: Lead, Data & AI Solutions – Enterprise Risk
description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) function supports Payoneer’s enterprise-wide risk governance, risk reporting, risk event management, issue management, risk assessments, controls and oversight processes.
  
  
This role will drive data, analytics, automation and AI-enabled transformation initiatives across the Risk & Resilience department. The role will lead enterprise risk data projects, strengthen risk analytics and reporting capabilities, and design and build practical AI-enabled solutions that improve Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) processes.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who can combine GRC process knowledge, system administration, data analysis, AI-enabled solution building and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
The successful candidate will help improve how risk and governance teams operate by simplifying workflows, improving data quality, automating manual processes, enhancing reporting, and identifying where AI or in-house tools can complement existing GRC platforms.
  
  
The role is well suited to someone who is analytical, technically curious, comfortable working in a fast-paced fintech environment, and motivated to build practical tools that improve governance, risk management, compliance, audit and decision-making.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead enterprise risk data and analytics projects from problem definition and requirements gathering through data sourcing, analysis, solution design, implementation and adoption.
* Support the development and execution of ERM’s data, analytics, automation and AI transformation roadmap, including identifying and prioritising high-value initiatives.
* Design and develop risk analytics, dashboards and management reporting across areas such as enterprise risk assessments, risk events, issues, controls, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), audit findings, remediation activities, root causes and emerging risks.
* Analyse risk and GRC data to identify trends, risk concentrations, recurring themes, control weaknesses, emerging risks and opportunities for management action.
* Design and implement automated processes for data collection, transformation, validation, analysis, reporting and stakeholder follow-up.
* Lead the design, prototyping and delivery of AI-enabled GRC solutions across risk assessments, issue management, risk event analysis, control monitoring, KRI management, reporting, knowledge management, classification, summarisation and thematic analysis.
* Translate business and risk requirements into clear solution designs, workflows, user journeys, data requirements, functional specifications, prototypes and acceptance criteria.
* Build and test practical solutions using data analytics, business intelligence, automation, generative AI and low-code or no-code development capabilities.
* Partner with Technology, Data, AI, Security and Privacy teams to determine appropriate technical approaches, data sources, integrations, architecture and implementation models.
* Establish appropriate controls for AI and automated solutions, including data sensitivity, privacy, security, access management, validation, reliability, explainability, documentation, auditability, monitoring and human oversight.
* Lead data quality reviews and improvement initiatives, including identifying data gaps, inconsistencies, duplicate information, outdated records and reporting limitations.
* Manage AI pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives, evaluate outcomes, incorporate user feedback, and develop plans for controlled implementation and broader adoption.
* Measure the effectiveness of departmental data, automation and AI initiatives through defined success measures, including efficiency gains, data quality improvements, user adoption, reporting accuracy and decision-making value.
* Prepare risk insights, dashboards and analytical outputs for senior management, governance forums and other key stakeholders.
* Support stakeholder engagement, training, change management and adoption activities for new analytics, automation and AI-enabled capabilities.
* Support broader ERM activities and enterprise-wide risk initiatives as needed, including risk assessments, risk monitoring, governance materials, management reporting, capital modelling and strategic projects.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Strong experience leading data, analytics, automation or technology-enabled transformation projects, preferably within enterprise risk management, operational risk, compliance, internal audit or another governance function.
* Strong understanding of risk and GRC processes, including risk assessments, risk events, issue management, control management, KRIs, audit findings, remediation tracking and governance reporting.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with complex and fragmented datasets and translate them into clear, actionable risk insights.
* Hands-on experience developing dashboards, analytical tools, automated reporting or data-driven solutions using business intelligence, data visualisation, query, automation or similar technologies.
* Practical experience designing, prototyping or building AI-enabled solutions, including generative AI, workflow automation, intelligent classification, summarisation, thematic analysis or knowledge management capabilities.
* Ability to translate business and risk problems into structured requirements, data needs, solution designs and practical implementation plans.
* Understanding of data management principles, including data quality, governance, lineage, access controls, validation, documentation and reporting accuracy.
* Strong project ownership skills, with the ability to manage initiatives from concept and design through development, testing, implementation and adoption.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain data, technical, AI and risk concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and deliver effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
* A hands-on mindset with a willingness to analyse data, build prototypes, test solutions, resolve problems, document outcomes and support implementation.
* Experience with business intelligence, data analytics, automation, low-code or no-code development, or AI-enabled development tools is strongly preferred.
* Experience with tools such as Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, Microsoft Power Platform, Lovable or similar technologies would be advantageous.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Risk Management, Business or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Five or more years of relevant experience in data analytics, automation, AI solution delivery, risk management, GRC transformation, operational risk, compliance, internal audit, technology risk or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience delivering data, analytics, automation or AI-enabled solutions from initial concept through implementation is required.
* Experience within fintech, financial services, payments, banking, technology or another regulated environment is preferred.
* Experience supporting Second Line or Third Line functions would be advantageous.

**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

title: Lead Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
Enable data-driven decision-making across Global Supply Management (GSM) by delivering actionable insights, predictive analytics, reporting visualizations and analytical automation. Support strategic vendor decisions, savings, risk management, efficiency, service quality and transparency through analytical tools and AI.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Data analytics and business insights**

* Translate unstructured business requests into analytical strategies and actionable insights.
* Perform analysis and research on strategic priorities using best-in-class analytical approaches, including predictive analysis, statistical modelling and data mining.
* Deliver ad-hoc analysis and clear presentations of results, including visualizations and MIS for senior leadership.
* Collaborate with analytical teams across American Express business units, using internal and external data sources to generate insights.

**Analytics tools, automation and data quality**

* Drive analytical capabilities within GSM and business units using cognitive and analytical tools and technologies.
* Enhance data collection procedures to capture information relevant to analytical systems.
* Process, cleanse and verify data integrity for analysis; create automated anomaly-detection systems and monitor their performance.
* Deliver high-quality, accurate analytical outputs on time, with close attention to detail.

**AI and GenAI enablement**

* Identify practical AI and GenAI opportunities for procurement analytics, insight generation, summarization and workflow efficiency.
* Support proofs of concept using approved AI tools and analytical technologies; evaluate accuracy, usefulness and business impact with stakeholder validation.
* Apply responsible AI principles, including data privacy, security, human review and appropriate governance when using AI-assisted outputs.
* Collaborate with business and technology partners to integrate validated AI-assisted insights into dashboards, reporting and repeatable processes.

**Solution design and stakeholder collaboration**

* Conduct feasibility studies and proofs of concept to validate functional specifications and translate them into technical specifications.
* Assess existing environments, identify opportunities and recommend alternative solutions to technical problems.
* Translate requirements into concepts and user-experience designs in partnership with stakeholders and business partners.
* Understand procurement processes and support translation of AS-IS processes into TO-BE models.

**Qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience in analytics.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree relevant to the industry; additional credentials are a plus.
* Strong analytical aptitude and experience with Tableau, SQL and Alteryx.
* Strong functional knowledge of procurement processes, including AS-IS and TO-BE process models.
* Excellent visual design skills and sensitivity to user–system interaction, including complex multi-panel interactive dashboards.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly to a global audience.

title: Software Development Engineer II, Relay Yard Automation, Relay Yard Automation
description:
**Description**
Amazon moves millions of packages daily through a global logistics network of Fulfillment Centers, Sort Centers, and Delivery Stations. Every facility has a trailer yard — the physical space where line-haul vehicles arrive, get loaded or unloaded, and depart. Tracking what's happening in these yards in real time (which trailers are where, what state they're in, who's arriving and departing) is a hard problem that sits at the intersection of physical operations and software systems.
  
  
The Relay Yard Automation (RYA) team builds the software that manages these trailer yards across 6,000+ Amazon facilities on three continents. Our products handle 200K+ gate transactions
  
  
per day and facilitated the arrival and departure of 55M vehicles last year. We integrate computer vision, RFID, GPS, ultrasonic sensors, and IoT edge devices to automate what were historically manual, associate-staffed processes, from gate check-in/check-out to in-yard trailer movements. Our gate automation program has already eliminated millions of manual transactions, with a long-term goal of fully autonomous yard operations.
  
  
The tech stack is diverse by necessity: Android mobile apps for yard associates and drivers, React web applications for remote gate agents and yard operators, Java/TypeScript backend services on AWS, and hardware integrations running on edge compute devices deployed in the field. Systems are loosely coupled, event-driven, and must operate reliably in environments ranging from 1M+ sq ft North American fulfillment centers to small urban European delivery stations.
  
  
As an SDE on this team, you will design and build features and services that power yard automation across Amazon's logistics network. You will write high-quality code across the full stack, contribute to system design discussions, and deliver projects from technical design through production launch. The role involves working across backend services, web and mobile applications, and integrations with physical sensor systems at the edge. You will make thoughtful engineering trade-offs, participate in design and code reviews, and contribute to the team's operational excellence practices — supporting tier-1 systems where your work directly impacts driver experience and Amazon's ability to meet customer delivery promises.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement software for yard and gate automation products across tier-1 systems. Your code runs in production where defects directly impact driver experience and customer delivery promises.
* Lead large projects end-to-end: define the technical approach in ambiguous problem spaces, decompose work into parallel workstreams, and deliver cohesive launches.
* Own system architecture for your team's services. Proactively simplify code, resolve architecture deficiencies, and remove bottlenecks across Java backend services, TypeScript/React web apps, Android mobile apps, and IoT edge devices.
* Make short-term vs. long-term trade-off decisions and communicate them clearly to your team and stakeholders.
* Integrate with physical systems — RFID readers, computer vision cameras, ultrasonic sensors, GPS — running on edge compute in variable warehouse environments. Debug problems that span hardware and cloud software.
* Own operational excellence for services you build: monitoring, alarming, runbooks, incident response, and root-cause corrective actions.
* Influence technical direction beyond your team through design reviews with partner teams across Transportation Technology.
* Act as a force multiplier. Raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design artifacts, and reusable frameworks. Mentor junior engineers toward their next level.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 3+ years of Video Games Industry (supporting title Development, Release, or Live Ops) experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Consulting Architect - Platform
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
  
  
**What is The Role:**
You are the person a customer calls when their Elasticsearch platform is the problem, or when they need one designed properly the first time.
  
  
That means you decide the shape of a cluster and then defend that decision — node topology, shard strategy, data tiers, lifecycle and retention — with the sizing arithmetic to back it up. It also means you can follow a performance problem beyond Elastic itself. We need someone whose instinct is to look down the stack and sideways to whatever else shares the infrastructure, rather than stopping at the cluster API.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing:**

* Design and build Elasticsearch platforms for customers across self-managed, orchestrated and managed deployments, including air-gapped and regulated environments
* Own sizing and capacity planning as a derivation from workload characteristics — ingest rate, document shape, retention, query concurrency, growth — validated by benchmark rather than estimated from a form
* Run health checks and remediation on production estates, and redesign sharding, mapping and index strategies where the original design no longer holds
* Lead major-version upgrades, snapshot and disaster recovery strategy, and multi-cluster architectures
* Diagnose performance problems across the full stack — Elastic, the JVM, the operating system, storage and network — and across adjacent systems in the data path
* Work directly with customer architects, platform owners and engineering leadership; run discovery, present designs, and own the technical outcome of an engagement end to end
* Build reusable tooling, automation and IP that makes the next engagement faster, including AI-assisted tooling for diagnosis, configuration and reporting
* Mentor other consultants and contribute to the GCC's technical practice

**What You Bring:**
**Elastic depth — non-negotiable**
We
**are not looking**
for someone who will learn Elastic on the job.
  
  

* 8+ years hands-on with the Elastic Stack, substantially on cluster and platform work rather than dashboarding or pipeline authoring
* Shard strategy you can derive, not recite — how you arrived at a shard count and size for a given workload, what you traded off, and what you got wrong the first time
* Index and mapping design, and why those choices drive cluster performance
* Lifecycle and retention across data tiers, including the cost and latency implications of each
* Snapshot, restore and disaster recovery designed and executed, not just configured
* Major-version upgrades in production — the sequencing, the breaking changes, the rollback position
* More than one deployment model: self-managed plus at least one managed or orchestrated option
* Cluster stability and performance troubleshooting — heap and garbage collection, circuit breakers, thread pool rejections, shard allocation, expensive queries
* Elastic Certified Engineer, or the demonstrable knowledge to obtain it within your first quarter
* Strong Linux and operating system fundamentals, with solid grounding in storage and networking
* A working understanding of how infrastructure conditions translate into Elastic symptoms, and how infrastructure choices constrain what a deployment can do
* Experience troubleshooting on shared infrastructure, where the cause of your problem is another workload's behaviour and resolving it means engaging the team that owns it

**Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:**
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
  
  
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
  
  

* Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
* Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
* Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
* Generous number of vacation days each year
* Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
* Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love

title: AI Manager
description:
**AI Manager**

**Location**

Gurugram (Udyog Vihar Phase III), on-site; occasional travel to project sites

**Reports To -**
Head of IT

**Experience -**
7 to 10 years

**Employment Type -**
Full-time, permanent

**THE OPPORTUNITY**

Most companies are still debating AI. We have decided to build it into how we engineer, bid, deliver and operate. WOG is looking for its first AI Manager to lead AI transformation and implementation across the company - deciding where AI goes to work, building it, and making sure it is adopted safely.

You will not be one voice in a large digital team. You will own the AI agenda end to end, with direct access to the CEO and leadership, and real engineering problems to solve - in water, wastewater and green energy.

**ABOUT WOG**

WOG Technologies is an IP-led engineering and technology company in water, wastewater and green energy, with 190+ projects delivered across 20+ countries and 350+ engineers. The group includes Bell Cooling Towers and the WOG Green Energy businesses - Green Coal, Carbon Loops, BESS, CBG and Carbon Credits. We are building a patent portfolio and a technology-first culture, and AI is central to that.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Set the AI agenda**

* Map how work flows across the business - proposals and bids, design and engineering, procurement, project delivery, plant operations and support functions - and find where AI saves the most time and money.
* Build and own a 12-month AI roadmap with a business case for every use case, and report the value delivered.

**Get the data ready**

* Organise the data AI depends on - document repositories, master data, and HR, finance and project records - so that AI answers are accurate and traceable.
* Set data ownership and quality standards with each function, starting with the data behind the first use cases.

**Build and ship AI solutions**

* Deploy enterprise AI tools - LLM assistants, document intelligence and workflow automation - and integrate them with our HRMS, ERP, Microsoft 365 and document systems.
* Design and deploy agentic AI: agents that carry out multi-step work across our systems, such as preparing tender responses, reconciling vendor quotes or compiling management reports, with people approving the key decisions.
* Automate high-effort work such as tender review, BOQ and estimation support, document control and management reporting.
* Explore AI for plant performance: predictive maintenance, process optimisation and remote monitoring.

**Make AI safe to use**

* Move WOG from restricted AI use to governed adoption: approved enterprise tools, a clear AI usage policy, and no company data in unapproved platforms.
* Configure data loss prevention (Microsoft Purview DLP) and sensitivity labels so AI tools see only what they should.
* Control what AI agents can access and do: least-privilege permissions, human approval for consequential actions, and full logging.
* Assess AI vendors for security, privacy and contractual risk; keep AI use compliant with the DPDP Act 2023 and IT Act 2000.

**Bring people along**

* Train employees and leaders to use AI well, and build a library of approved prompts, templates and agents.
* Work hand in hand with the IT team, which runs infrastructure and cyber security.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

**Must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, computer applications or a related discipline.
* 7 to 10 years in technology, digital transformation or engineering roles, including hands-on generative AI work since late 2022.
* AI work you can show us: at least two AI solutions taken to production in an organisation, with measurable results.
* Working knowledge of Python, APIs and low-code automation, and of data protection in Microsoft 365 (DLP, sensitivity labels, access controls).
* An AI certification or programme from a reputed institute (IIT, IISc, IIM, ISB or a global equivalent) or a recognised vendor (Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS).
* Interest in engineering businesses, with understanding of the water and wastewater industry or a willingness to learn it quickly.

**Good to have**

* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Engineering or Computer Science.
* A cyber security certification - CISSP, CISM, CEH, CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-401 / SC-300.
* Hands-on experience building agentic AI workflows (multi-step agents with tool access) in production.
* Postgraduate degree in AI, Machine Learning or Data Science.
* Experience in engineering, infrastructure, utilities, energy or manufacturing companies.

If you meet most of the must-haves and have shipped real AI work, apply. We hire for proven ability, not a perfect checklist.

**WHY WOG**

* Build it, don't maintain it: you are the first person in this role and shape how a whole company works.
* Direct line to leadership: your roadmap goes to the CEO, not through layers.
* Real-world impact and a broad canvas: water, wastewater and five green energy businesses.

title: Lead AI Ops Engineer
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Lead AI Ops Engineer
  
  
AI Ops
  
  
**Overview**
Mastercard's Operational Intelligence team is building the next generation of data products and AI solutions that help customers access and use operational insights in new ways. As AI agents move from POC to production, their behavior keeps changing in real time: the context they retrieve, the skills they select, how they resolve exceptions. These agents are never really “finished.” They keep learning from production outcomes, so their reliability, safety, and trustworthiness need to be actively operated, not just monitored. That is the job of AI Ops: making sure each agent’s reasoning stays correct, its context stays current, and its behavior stays governed as it learns.
  
  
**Role**

* Own end to end production monitoring for one or more AI agents, tracking key metrics, KPIs, accuracy, latency, SLA breaches, guardrail triggers, and out of scope rates through dedicated observability dashboards
* Serve as L1/L2 production support, providing first response monitoring, triage, and escalation to tech teams as new agentic services go live
* Identify and diagnose issues by monitoring eval scores and drift alerts, inspecting failing traces and patterns, and classifying root causes such as intent, tool, parameter, or hallucination errors
* Evaluate whether the agent’s reasoning remains correct in production, checking whether context retrieval stays current, whether resolutions match ground truth, and whether the learning loop is drifting
* Monitor and manage post production reliability, including API and authentication failures and issues originating from external AI endpoints, to protect revenue generating, client facing agents
* Partner with AI Engineering to prioritize fixes, run experiments on prompts, context, and routing in Dev, and validate improvements via evals before handing off proven changes for deployment
* Embed governance within the agent’s learning loop so that approval workflows and audit logging travel with every production change, rather than being added after the fact

**All About You**

* Experience monitoring or operating production AI/ML or agentic systems, including observability, evaluation, and drift detection practices
* Strong analytical skills to diagnose root causes across intent classification, tool selection, parameter errors, and hallucination patterns
* Understanding of AI/LLM observability concepts such as tracing, telemetry, guardrails, and evaluation engineering including benchmarks, automated evals, human review, and regression testing
* Familiarity with governance, compliance, and responsible AI practices such as PII detection, access control, audit logging, and policy enforcement is a plus
* Ability to work independently alongside existing Tech teams while owning a dedicated agent’s post launch health
* Excellent communication skills to translate production signals into clear, prioritized asks for AI Product and AI Engineering teams
* Comfort working in a fast evolving environment where the process itself, not just the throughput, is what is being continuously operated on and improved

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:

**About Innefu Labs**

Innefu specialises in building secure, high-performance products for sensitive and mission-critical environments, with a strong focus on innovation, reliability, scalability, and customer satisfaction

**Role Overview:**
Makes the robot walk, climb and recover on mud, rock, snow and stairs — designing and training the gait controller in simulation and transferring it to the real robot.

**Experience:**
3–8 years,

**Education:**
MTech/PhD with a thesis on legged locomotion. BTech/MTech/PhD in Mechanical, Electrical, Aerospace, Robotics or Control Systems. Very few people in India have built legged robots, so a strong humanoid, exoskeleton or legged-research background also counts.

**Responsibilities**

* Build the simulation environment with randomised rough terrain.
* Develop gaits (walk, trot, stairs, crawl) using reinforcement learning, model predictive control (MPC), or both.
* Transfer controllers from simulation to the real robot (sim-to-real) and tune them in field tests.
* Write state estimation (body pose and velocity) from IMU and joint sensors.
* Specify actuator and leg requirements to choose the off-the-shelf supplier.

**Must have**

* C++ and Python.
* Rigid-body dynamics and control theory: MPC, whole-body control, or RL for locomotion (PPO).
* At least one physics simulator: Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab, MuJoCo, PyBullet, Gazebo or RaiSim.
* Has run a controller on real robot hardware, not only in simulation.

**Good to have**

* Hands-on with commercial quadrupeds (Unitree, ANYmal, Spot, Deep Robotics) or their SDKs.
* Open-source legged stacks: legged\_gym, OCS2, Pinocchio, Drake, Crocoddyl.
* Publications at ICRA, IROS, CoRL, RSS or Humanoids.
* Kalman filters / state estimation; terrain-aware foothold planning.
* PyTorch, GPU training, domain randomisation.

title: Global M&C Data Architect Director & Chapter Lead – MarTech
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
The MarTech Data Architect & Data Engineering Chapter Lead for Marketing & Communications is a senior technical leader responsible for the engineering excellence, architectural integrity, and continuous evolution of BCG's marketing data foundation and connected platforms. Sitting within the MarTech Engineering team, this person leads the data engineering chapter that serves BCG's Global Marketing analytics and data functions owning the technical standards, pipeline architecture, and data platform capability that underpins the full marketing analytics and data ecosystem, from CRM data operations and audience segmentation through to Tableau dashboard delivery, channel performance intelligence, and AI-assisted insight generation.
  
  
A core part of this ownership is the identity resolution model the framework that matches and unifies client and contact records across marketing data and CRM systems into a single trusted profile. The Chapter Lead designs, manages, and continually refines this model, and partners closely with BCG's core data architect, client, marketing, CRM and engineering teams and data functions to maintain a shared, consistent definition of identity across systems.
  
  
This role also carries direct responsibility for aligning the marketing data layer with BCG's wider enterprise data approach. The Chapter Lead partners with enterprise data governance and architecture teams to ensure marketing's data standards, access controls, lineage, and quality practices are built to firm-wide policy rather than developed in isolation representing marketing's needs in enterprise governance forums while bringing enterprise requirements back into the marketing data roadmap.
  
  
The role sits at the intersection of technical leadership and marketing analytics product delivery. The Chapter Lead is not only the most senior data engineering voice they are an active partner to the product owners, analysts, and insight leaders whose work depends on the reliability, quality, and sophistication of the data infrastructure this person builds and leads. They lead and develop the data engineering team, set the data engineering direction in line witht the overall MarTech strategy and standards, establish the data standards, and ensure that BCG's marketing data platforms are capable of supporting not just today's analytics needs but the agentic intelligent data environment the marketing organization is building toward.
  
  
Chapter Leadership & Data Engineering Development
  
  

* Lead the data engineering chapter serving BCG's Global Marketing & Communications team setting technical direction, establishing engineering standards, and creating an environment where engineers across squads are developing their skills, doing their best work, and growing their careers
* Provide architectural oversight and hands-on review of engineering work across the chapter code quality, architectural consistency, pipeline reliability, and data modeling standards are upheld across all squads the chapter serves
* Actively mentor and develop chapter engineers conducting regular technical reviews, providing structured feedback, identifying growth opportunities, and building the collective engineering capability that allows the chapter to take on increasingly sophisticated data and AI challenges over time
* Partner with squad product owners to ensure engineering capacity, technical priorities, and sprint commitments are aligned with the analytical products and insight capabilities the marketing organization depends on
* Contribute to hiring decisions, team structure, and data engineering development helping build a chapter that is technically excellent, well-motivated, and capable of sustaining the marketing analytics function's growing ambitions

Data Pipeline Architecture & Engineering
  
  

* Design, document, and implement robust, scalable data pipelines that feed the marketing analytics data models powering BCG's dashboard suite, channel insight products, audience intelligence, and CRM data operations built on Snowflake, dbt, and Apache Airflow as the core platform stack
* Build monitoring and alerting for match-rate quality, pipeline failures, and unexpected shifts in merge/split volume Establish a lineage trail so any resolved identity can be traced back to its contributing source records and the logic that merged them
* Build processes to handle un-merging (splitting incorrectly merged records) as well as merging
* Implement data standardization logic (name normalization, address formatting, email canonicalization) as a pre-processing layer ahead of matching
* Integrate data from across BCG's marketing technology ecosystem into the marketing data environment in a structured, governed, and scalable way that supports both current reporting needs and future analytical capability
* Apply SCD, CDC, and DQ/DV frameworks rigorously across pipeline development ensuring that data arriving in the marketing master dataset is accurate, complete, historically traceable, and fit for the analytical and insight purposes it is intended to serve
* Evaluate and implement new technical solutions, data engineering patterns, and platform capabilities that improve the reliability, performance, and sophistication of BCG's marketing data infrastructure contributing MVPs and proofs of concept that demonstrate feasibility before committing to full implementation

Data Quality, Governance & Security
  
  

* Own the data quality and governance standards for BCG's marketing data engineering environment implementing the monitoring, validation, and alerting frameworks that catch data quality issues before they surface as errors in stakeholder-facing dashboards or analytical outputs
* Implement data performance and data security policies that align with BCG's governance objectives, regulatory requirements, and privacy obligations working in close partnership with enterprise data governance, IT security, and legal colleagues to ensure the marketing data environment meets the firm's standards across all dimensions
* Maintain clear, accessible documentation of data models, pipeline architecture, transformation logic, and engineering decisions building institutional knowledge that reduces key-person dependency and supports the chapter's resilience as it grows

AI & Identity Resolution Architecture
  
  

* Design the end-to-end identity resolution architecture spanning CRM, marketing automation, web/behavioral data, campaign platforms, and third-party data sources
* Define the matching strategy: deterministic rules (exact matches on email, phone, CRM ID) vs. probabilistic matching (fuzzy name/address matching, behavioral signals), and when each applies
* Design the "golden record" / unified profile structure what fields it contains, how conflicting values are resolved, and which source system wins for each data type
* Build a confidence-scoring framework so matches are tiered (auto-merge, flag-for-review, reject) rather than treated as all-or-nothing
* Define the survivorship rules most recent, most complete, most trusted source that determine what data persists into the unified profile when records merge
* Design for scale and extensibility so new data sources (new martech tools, new regions, new business lines) can be onboarded without re-architecting the core model

Technical Monitoring & Incident Management
  
  

* Actively monitor the health, performance, and reliability of BCG's marketing data pipelines and Snowflake environment — establishing the observability frameworks, alerting standards, and incident response protocols that minimize disruption to the analytical products and insight outputs the marketing organization depends on
* Lead the triage and resolution of critical technical incidents with urgency, clarity, and sound engineering judgment — communicating clearly with product owners and stakeholders throughout, and ensuring that root cause analysis and remediation are completed systematically rather than reactively
* Identify and address performance bottlenecks across the data engineering environment — conducting regular performance reviews and implementing optimization improvements that keep the platform scalable and responsive as data volumes, analytical complexity, and user demand grow

Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Partnership
  
  

* Build strong working relationships with external stakeholders across BCG's global data and technology organization ensuring that marketing's data engineering work is aligned with firm-wide data standards and that dependencies are managed proactively
* Partner with IT architecture and platform teams on shared infrastructure decisions — including AWS cloud services, Azure Active Directory integration, and CI/CD pipeline tooling — ensuring marketing's engineering choices are compatible with BCG's broader technology environment
* Engage with product portfolio management and cross-functional data product teams across finance, HR, legal, and other BCG functions — contributing a marketing analytics perspective to firm-wide data platform conversations and maintaining awareness of cross-functional data and security trends that affect the marketing data environment

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Leading a chapter of data engineers with technical authority and genuine investment in their development — you set a high bar, model it yourself, and bring people along rather than simply holding them to it
* Designing data pipeline architectures and Snowflake data models that are not just technically correct but genuinely built for the analytical consumption patterns of a sophisticated marketing analytics function — you think about the downstream insight need as much as the upstream engineering requirement
* Writing advanced SQL and well-structured dbt models that your colleagues can read, understand, maintain, and build on — you treat code quality and documentation as professional obligations, not optional extras
* Navigating the intersection of data engineering and marketing analytics with enough domain fluency to engage credibly with product owners, analysts, and insight leaders — you understand what they are trying to build and why, and you engineer solutions that serve those needs rather than just satisfying technical requirements
* Bringing a current and practical perspective on AI and its implications for data engineering — you are not evangelizing AI for its own sake, but you have a well-formed view of where intelligent automation, Snowflake Cortex, and LLM integration create genuine engineering opportunity in a marketing analytics context
* Staying calm and effective in critical incidents — you triage with sound judgment, communicate clearly under pressure, and resolve issues systematically rather than reactively
* Collaborating with product owners and Agile teams in a way that adds engineering value to product decisions — you show up to sprint ceremonies prepared, you flag technical risk early, and you help the squad make better product decisions by making the engineering trade-offs visible and understandable

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 13+ years of data engineering experience with a strong focus on data warehouse architecture, pipeline development, and data modeling, including at least 2–3 years in a chapter lead, technical lead, or senior engineering leadership role
* Demonstrably advanced SQL proficiency and deep hands-on experience with Snowflake — including data modeling, performance optimization, security configuration, and consumption layer design for analytical workloads
* Expert-level proficiency with dbt for data transformation and data model development, and strong hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for pipeline orchestration and job scheduling
* Solid experience applying SCD, CDC, and DQ/DV frameworks in production data engineering environments — you have built these patterns, maintained them, and debugged them when they break
* Demonstrated ability to write clean, well-documented, version-controlled code — you use GitHub or Bitbucket as a professional standard, not an afterthought
* Experience integrating data from complex, multi-platform marketing or enterprise technology ecosystems — familiarity with platforms such as Dynamics CRM, Adobe Analytics, Marketo, Sprinklr, or equivalent marketing technology is a meaningful advantage
* Working knowledge of AI and machine learning concepts as they apply to data engineering — including intelligent pipeline orchestration, AI-assisted data quality, and the evolving role of Snowflake Cortex or equivalent capabilities in analytics environments
* Strong Python scripting skills for pipeline development, automation, and data engineering tooling; experience with PowerShell or equivalent a plus
* Experience with cloud platforms — AWS preferred, Azure and GCP also valued — and familiarity with CI/CD pipeline tooling and version control workflows in a production data engineering environment
* Experience working in Agile and scrum-based delivery environments — including active participation in sprint ceremonies, backlog grooming, and cross-functional squad collaboration with product owners, architects, and data SMEs
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — including the ability to present architecture decisions, engineering trade-offs, and technical recommendations to non-technical product owners and marketing stakeholders clearly and confidently
* Experience with JIRA and Confluence for delivery management and technical documentation
* Familiarity with other data platforms including Oracle, SQL Server, or MDM systems is a plus
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Data Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Who You'll Work With
  
  
This role operates within BCG's Global Marketing analytics and data hub functions as the senior technical leader of the data engineering chapter that serves it. Your most important day-to-day working relationships are with the engineers in your chapter — the people whose technical growth, work quality, and professional development you are directly accountable for — and with the product owners across the marketing analytics and data hub squads whose roadmaps depend on the reliability and capability of the engineering infrastructure your chapter builds and maintains.
  
  
Within the analytics function, you will partner closely with the Director of Marketing Analytics and the Director of Data Hub who run the squads who access, monitor, and deliver insights and data driven insights for the global marketing organization. You will also collaborate with the CRM data operations and CRM engineering leads — ensuring that the data quality and governance standards that apply at the platform level are reflected in the CRM data environment that feeds the broader marketing analytics ecosystem.
  
  
Beyond the marketing analytics and data hub functions, you will be expected to engage regularly with BCG's enterprise data organization to ensure marketing's engineering work is aligned with firm-wide data standards and that shared infrastructure decisions reflect marketing's needs. You will also work with IT architecture, cloud platform, and security colleagues on the infrastructure and governance dimensions of the marketing data environment.
  
  
At the most senior level, you will engage with the Director of Marketing Analytics & Data and Director of Data Hub as a peer and strategic partner — contributing the engineering perspective that shapes how the function's data platform capability evolves, how AI and emerging technology are incorporated into the chapter's roadmap, and how BCG's marketing analytics and data infrastructure is positioned to support the organization's most ambitious data and insight ambitions.
  
  
This is a role for a data engineering leader who finds genuine satisfaction in the combination of deep technical craft and organizational impact — who wants to build something that is not just technically excellent but genuinely indispensable to how a world-class marketing organization understands and acts on its data.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Manager - Fraud Prevention
description:
**About Sirius AI**

Sirius AI is a US-headquartered AI consulting and products company with operations in India. We work with financial services organizations across geographies to solve business problems using data, AI and technology. Our teams combine consulting, industry, product and engineering expertise to build practical solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Manager in our AI driven Fraud prevention practice. You will shape the strategy, solutions and delivery of AI-driven fraud detection and prevention for banks, payments companies, lenders, insurers and fintechs.

This is a senior role that combines deep fraud domain expertise, hands-on technical credibility, client leadership and team building. You will own our fraud AI offerings end-to-end, from client conversations and solution design through to models running in production and delivering measurable reductions in fraud losses.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead client engagements end-to-end, from discovery and solution design through model development, deployment and value realization.
* Be the SME and guide delivery of use cases such as card and payments fraud, application and identity fraud, synthetic identities, account takeover, first-party fraud, authorized push payment (APP) scams and mule account detection but using new age AI techniques including graph-based reasoning and transformer architectures.
* Define and drive the strategy and roadmap for Sirius AI’s Fraud prevention AI offerings, including solution accelerators, reusable assets and product capabilities.
* Guide the team on modelling approaches including supervised and unsupervised machine learning, anomaly detection, graph and network analytics, transformer-based models, behavioral and device signals, agentic AI implementations and real-time scoring.
* Ensure client delivery use cases meet MRM and regulatory specs for explainability, validation and ongoing monitoring.
* Build, mentor and lead a high-performing team of data scientists, AI engineers ML engineers and analysts; set technical standards and contribute to hiring.
* Support business development through proposals, solution demonstrations, proofs of concept and client presentations, and help grow existing accounts.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related quantitative field; a PhD or MBA is a plus.
* 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics or AI, including at least 3 years focused on fraud, financial crime or risk in financial services.
* A proven track record of taking fraud models into production and delivering measurable business impact.
* Deep understanding of fraud typologies, the fraud lifecycle and fraud operations, including alerting, investigation, case management and chargebacks.
* Strong grounding in machine learning (gradient boosting, neural networks, anomaly detection, graph methods) and working proficiency in Python and SQL, with the ability to review and challenge the team’s technical work.
* Familiarity with fraud platforms and data sources such as FICO Falcon, NICE Actimize, Feature space or SAS Fraud Management, and with device, identity and consortium data.
* 3+ years of experience leading teams, and confidence managing senior stakeholders
* Consulting or client-facing experience, including solution selling, pre-sales and engagement management.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes.

**Good to Have**

* Experience delivering fraud solutions across multiple geographies, such as the US, UK, Europe or SE Asia.
* Hands-on exposure to real-time streaming technologies (Kafka, Flink) and cloud ML platforms

title: Consultant - Actuarial Services
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION | CONSULTANT – ACTUARIAL SERVICES**

**Company Description:**

DHA-1 is a US-headquartered consulting and managed services firm focused exclusively on the global Property & Casualty (P&C) insurance industry. We support insurers, reinsurers, MGAs, brokers, and insurtechs across specialized functions, including underwriting and portfolio operations, actuarial and catastrophe modeling, AI enablement, and technology implementation.

We combine insurance domain knowledge, technical expertise, and dedicated teams to help clients manage complex workflows, improve operational efficiency, and build scalable capabilities.

**Role Description:**

We are seeking a technically skilled and proactive Consultant to join our growing actuarial practice in India.

In this role, you will work on diverse actuarial engagements for global P&C insurers, reinsurers, and MGAs, covering pricing, rating model development, reserving, portfolio analytics, and process automation.

Working alongside senior actuarial professionals, you will own assigned analytical deliverables, develop and validate actuarial models, analyze complex datasets, and collaborate with underwriting, catastrophe modeling, and technology teams.

The role offers an opportunity to work directly on international client engagements while contributing to

the development of DHA-1's actuarial capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Pricing & Rating Plan Support**

* Perform rate adequacy analyses, trend studies, loss cost assessments, and experience-based pricing across P&C lines of business.
* Develop, test, and validate technical pricing models, rating tools, and rating plan components.
* Support rating plan development, bureau benchmarking, and technical documentation for new products, market entries, and program expansions.

**Reserving & Claims Analytics**

* Prepare reserve reviews, loss evaluations, and loss development triangle analyses using established actuarial methodologies.
* Analyze claims development, loss trends, Loss Adjustment Expenses (LAE), and large-loss experience.
* Support reserve adequacy assessments, actuarial reporting, and documentation of key assumptions and findings.

**Portfolio Analytics & Cross-Functional Integration**

* Analyze portfolio performance, profitability, loss ratios, and emerging experience trends to support business decisions.
* Develop portfolio monitoring dashboards, recurring reports, and scenario or sensitivity analyses.
* Collaborate with underwriting, catastrophe modeling, and other teams to integrate actuarial insights into portfolio management.

**Programming & Process Automation**

* Develop and maintain actuarial models, analytical routines, and reporting tools using Excel, Python, R, or SQL.
* Automate recurring data processing, actuarial calculations, validation, and reporting workflows.
* Perform data cleansing, reconciliation, model validation, and documentation to ensure accuracy and consistency.

**Client Delivery & Quality Assurance**

* Own assigned actuarial deliverables, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to agreed requirements.
* Conduct quality checks, validate assumptions and outputs, and maintain clear technical documentation.
* Collaborate with global client teams and senior actuarial professionals to communicate findings, address queries, and support project delivery.

**Qualifications:**

**Experience**

* 3–6 years of hands-on actuarial experience in Property & Casualty / General Insurance.
* Practical experience in pricing, rating model development, reserving, or portfolio analytics.
* Experience supporting US or UK commercial insurance markets is preferred.

**Actuarial Credentials**

* Actively pursuing actuarial designation through IFoA, IAI, CAS, or an equivalent professional body.
* Preferably four or more actuarial examinations cleared. Candidates with fewer examinations and strong relevant experience may also be considered.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas, data modeling, and analytical tool development.
* Working proficiency in Python or R for data manipulation, statistical analysis, or automation.
* Experience with SQL, VBA, or actuarial modeling platforms would be an advantage.

**Domain Knowledge**

* Good understanding of P&C pricing principles, rating methodologies, and insurance loss experience.
* Familiarity with reserving methodologies and loss development techniques.
* Exposure to commercial casualty pricing, excess insurance, ILFs, or reinsurance analytics would be an advantage.

**Analytical & Communication Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with attention to accuracy and detail.
* Ability to independently execute analytical assignments and manage competing deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings to global stakeholders.
* Ability to collaborate across actuarial, underwriting, CAT modeling, and technology functions.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Actuarial Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or another quantitative discipline.

**Join Our Team:**

At DHA-1, you will have the opportunity to work on diverse actuarial engagements for global insurance clients, collaborate with experienced industry professionals, and help grow our actuarial practice.

We offer a collaborative environment that encourages professional development, technical learning, and opportunities to take ownership of meaningful client work.

**Cloud, Architecture & Technical Feasibility**

title: Applied AI Architect
description:

title: AI / ML Engineer
description:
**About Digiryze Pro**

Digiryze Pro builds software products and custom technology solutions for healthcare and manufacturing. Our work includes a cloud-based healthcare management platform with a built-in AI voice assistant, AI-powered visual inspection systems for automotive and manufacturing plants, and machine-data and production dashboards for industrial clients.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an AI/ML Engineer who has built and deployed AI features in real products. You will work on two tracks: LLM- and voice-based assistants inside our software products, and computer-vision systems running on factory production lines. The ideal candidate can take a problem from data collection to a working, deployed system.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and improve AI assistants using large language models (Gemini, OpenAI, Claude or similar), including prompt design, tool/function calling, and connecting the assistant to application APIs and databases.
* Build retrieval (RAG) pipelines so assistants answer accurately from product and business data.
* Implement and tune speech-to-text and text-to-speech for voice interaction, including Indian languages and accents.
* Develop computer-vision models for defect detection, part inspection and face recognition using OpenCV and deep-learning models (YOLO or similar).
* Collect, label and prepare image and text datasets; train, test and measure model accuracy.
* Deploy models on cloud servers and on-site industrial PCs, connected with cameras and plant systems.
* Build backend APIs (FastAPI / Flask / Django) that expose AI features to web and mobile applications.
* Monitor model performance in production, fix failures, and control AI usage costs.
* Work with the development team on integration, testing and releases.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Languages: Python (strong); SQL.
* ML / Deep Learning: PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, NumPy, Pandas.
* Computer Vision: OpenCV, YOLO or similar object-detection / segmentation models, image preprocessing.
* LLMs: LLM APIs (Gemini / OpenAI / Claude), prompt engineering, function/tool calling, RAG, vector databases.
* Speech: Experience with speech-to-text (e.g. Whisper) and text-to-speech systems.
* Backend: FastAPI, Flask or Django; REST APIs; JSON.
* Deployment: Linux, Docker, Git; deploying models on cloud and on-premise machines.
* Databases: MySQL or PostgreSQL.

**Good to Have**

* Integrating AI services with PHP / MySQL web applications.
* Edge deployment (GPU PCs, NVIDIA Jetson, ONNX / TensorRT optimisation).
* Industrial camera setups, lighting, or PLC/machine data integration.
* Hindi and regional-language speech or text processing.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* B.Tech / B.E. / MCA / M.Tech in Computer Science, AI, Data Science or a related field.
* 2–4 years of hands-on work building and deploying AI/ML systems in production, not only academic projects.
* A portfolio, GitHub, or clear examples of deployed AI projects.
* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; able to work independently.

**Work Location and Travel**

* Full-time, on-site at our Westend Mall, Janakpuri (West Delhi) office.
* Occasional visits to client manufacturing plants in Delhi NCR or outside Delhi, for installation and testing of vision systems.

**How to Apply**

Apply through LinkedIn with your updated resume and links to your AI projects (GitHub, demos or deployed work).

title: Data Platform Architect
description:
**Project Role :**

15 years full time education
  
  
**Role Summary / Description**
AI Powered Tech Talent
  
  
As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement.
  
  
Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design.
  
  
Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers.
  
  
Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity.
  
  
Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions.
  
  
Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards.
  
  
Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
  
  
Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
  
  
Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
  
  
Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.
  
  
Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards.
  
  
Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.

* Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Be accountable for building a winning data engineering team – driven by making data a core asset for McCormick.

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer (DP203+AZ305)

* Experience with data visualization software (Power BI preferred).
* Experience with building data pipelines.
* Experience with knowledge graphs.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Knowledge of data analysis, visualization techniques, and frameworks.

* SQL, Fabric, Databricks, Synapse, Azure Data Factory, Azure ML, Azure DevOps (for CI/CD),

Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions.
  
  
Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages.
  
  
Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling.
  
  
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment.
  
  
Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills.
  
  
Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions.
  
  
Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.
  
  
**Required Skills/ Experience**
Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations.
  
  
Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access.
  
  
Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices.
  
  
Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance.
  
  
Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.

Industry experience in BFSI, healthcare, retail/e-commerce, telecom, manufacturing, energy or public sector environments where data/AI platforms must meet compliance, security, reliability and cost-control requirements.
  
  
Exposure to Snowpark, Cortex/AI features, vector search, retrieval pipelines, feature engineering, model enablement and AI application architecture.
