title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Voice AI / Telephony) - Delhi
description:
**Job Title: Forward Deployed Engineer**
Experience: 4-6 Years
  
  
**About the Company:**
Blue Machines builds production Voice AI for India's largest enterprises—handling millions of live conversations in Hindi, Hinglish, and regional languages. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will design, build, integrate, support, and debug production-grade AI agents end-to-end. You are directly responsible for the delivery and execution of your agent, not a partner handing off to it. You will bridge the gap between client systems and the Blue Machines platform across APIs, cloud services, and AI frameworks.
  
  
**The Role**
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who bridges the gap between deep software engineering, cutting edge AI agent orchestration, and client delivery. In this role, you aren't just writing specifications or handing off prototypes you directly design, build, deploy, optimize, and debug production AI agents end-to-end. You will embed deeply with client environments to build seamless integrations while taking full technical ownership of agent performance in the wild.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* End-to-End AI Agent Architecture: Design, prompt, build, and deploy production voice agents, including guardrails, conversation design, and tool-calling logic
* Production Integration Engineering: Build scalable backend integrations (REST APIs, WebSockets, webhooks, callbacks, CRM writes) connecting the Blue Machines platform with enterprise systems
* AI Orchestration & Ecosystems: Implement AI/LLM frameworks using LangChain, OpenAI APIs, or similar SDKs to deliver intelligent workflows
* System Observability & Root-Cause Analysis: Read system logs, traces, and call flows to run rigorous root-cause analysis—proving whether an issue stems from prompt design, platform layer, or data pipelines
* Agent Evaluation & Funnel Optimization: Continuously monitor and optimize agent metrics (completion rate, hallucination rate, latency, cost) and run funnel experiments on conversation cadence
* Client Technical Leadership: Partner directly with client engineering teams, lead technical workshops, manage expectations with clarity, and travel for live-call reviews

**What We Look For**

* Core Experience: (4-6) years of software development experience, with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience shipping live LLM/AI applications (agents, RAG, or chatbots; voice experience is a plus)
* Core Backend Skills: Proficiency in Python or Java for backend architecture and integration work
* Cloud & Web Architecture: Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (preferably GCP) along with deep knowledge of APIs, WebSockets, and auth protocols (OAuth2, JWT)
* Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling and analyzing data independently using SQL, Python, or Sheets
* Communication & Presence: Strong client-facing communication skills with the ability to explain technical complexities in plain terms
* Mobility: Willingness to travel for on-site client workshops and deployment reviews

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of telephony stacks and real-time protocols (SIP, WebRTC, Twilio, Avaya, Ubona)
* Experience with Voice AI or Conversational AI Systems

title: Lead, AI Engineering
description:
*Application submission deadline, 26 October 2026*

**What Makes Us a Great Place to Work**

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on
 


Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list

 
and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

 

**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**

Bain’s
 


AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team

 

works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into r

obust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.

 

**The Impact You’ll Have**

Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.

  

As an AI Engineer in AIS, you will build the technical core of these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.

**The Role**

The Lead AI Engineer will design, build, and ship generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. You will contribute across the full development lifecycle — from early experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment — collaborating closely with senior engineers, product managers, and data scientists. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with growing influence on technical direction and an opportunity to begin mentoring more junior team members.

  

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

  

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

**What You’ll Do**

* Contribute to the design, development, and deployment of end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Build and iterate on multi-component AI pipelines, including:
  + Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  + Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
  + Embedding generation and optimization
  + Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)
* Implement reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across AI workflows
* Build and contribute to agentic systems, applying sound engineering principles around separation of concerns, memory architecture, and tool integration
* Contribute across the full stack: model experimentation, evaluation design, and production system deployment
* Build and maintain APIs, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments with attention to observability and reliability
* Support and help build GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:
  + Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
  + Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards
* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:
  + Hallucination rate and factual consistency
  + Relevance and precision/recall
  + Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
  + Cost tracking and efficiency
* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Contribute technical insights and communicate findings clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and, where relevant, clients
* Share knowledge with peers and support a culture of technical learning around RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* 3–5+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience shipping generative AI features or systems end-to-end, from prototyping through production
* Clear communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical collaborators and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, product, and data science teams; some experience supporting or informally mentoring peers is a plus
* Solid prompt engineering and context engineering skills; familiarity with conversation design principles
* Working knowledge of evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM applications
* Experience with:
  + RAG architectures (vector-based retrieval; exposure to hybrid or graph-based approaches is a plus)
  + Agentic patterns (tool use, routing, memory management; multi-agent systems experience is a plus)
  + ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
  + AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Familiarity with cost and latency tradeoffs when working with LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Eagerness to grow into a technical leadership role and support junior team members
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

  

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

title: Intern - AI/ML
description:
Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.
  
  
Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.
  
  
At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best.
  
  
At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Building and evaluating multi-agent systems, including agent orchestration, tool-calling, and integration with protocols and frameworks such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent skills.
* Implementing agentic coding tools, such as Claude Code, to accelerate development, automate workflows, and build internal tooling.
* Developing and implementing statistical and machine learning algorithms and models to support business and technical requirements.
* Contributing to MLOps practices for deploying, monitoring, and maintaining machine learning models in production environments.
* Analyzing model performance through experiments and testing, while contributing to the optimization and fine-tuning of existing models.

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD degree (ongoing or completed), or equivalent qualification, from a top university, with availability to join an in-office internship for six months starting January 2027.
* Expertise in modern agentic AI tooling is required, including agentic coding assistants such as Claude Code (or similar), building multi-agent systems, and integrating with protocols and frameworks such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent skills.
* Experience training, building, and deploying machine learning models using TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with MLOps practices for model deployment, productionization, and lifecycle management.
* Strong knowledge of Python, with hands-on experience using Linux, SQL, Git, and Bash scripting.
* A background in or experience with the finance domain is a plus.

Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.
  
  
At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.
  
  
Our benefits include:
  
  

* Generous paid time off policies
* Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
* Hybrid working opportunities
* Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
* In-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)
* Company-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
* Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
* Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
* Workshops and continuous learning opportunities

At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.
  
  
Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Associate Technology L2_Python
description:
**Job Description**
Publicis Sapient is looking for Python Developers to join our team of bright thinkers and enablers. You will use your problem-solving skills, craft, and creativity to design and develop infrastructure interfaces for complex business applications. You will build and orchestrate agentic, GenAI-powered workflows that transform how our clients operate – from data ingestion and enrichment to intelligent, LLM-driven automation. We are on a mission to transform the world, and you will be instrumental in shaping how we do it with your ideas, thoughts, and solutions.
  
  
**Your Impact:**

* Build and orchestrate agentic workflows using LangChain and LangGraph to power scalable, production-ready GenAI solutions.
* Develop reusable components for data ingestion, transformation, enrichment, and validation that accelerate delivery across projects.
* Ensure reliability, scalability, and traceability across agent workflows to support dependable, enterprise-grade AI applications.
* Implement performance monitoring with tools like LangSmith and apply tuning mechanisms to continuously improve agent accuracy and efficiency.
* Deploy and maintain Python-based GenAI services in production, leveraging Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools for reliable releases.
* Architect secure API communication and access management, using JWT, OAuth, and RBAC, to safeguard sensitive client data.
* Apply NLP, LLM, and retrieval techniques, including vector stores and embeddings, to build context-aware, intelligent solutions for clients.

**Qualifications**
**Your Skills & Experience:**

* Strong Python fundamentals (OOP, data structures, error handling) with hands-on experience using Pandas, NumPy, PySpark, or Dask.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, and Semantic Kernel, building agent orchestration, memory, and tool-use workflows.
* Proficiency in Python API frameworks (Flask/FastAPI), with experience using IDEs such as VSCode and PyCharm.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, time-series data, and data modeling and schema design.
* Basic integration experience with TensorFlow or PyTorch, plus exposure to vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Chroma) and embedding-based retrieval.
* Proficiency with AWS Cloud Services and production deployment practices, including Bitbucket, Git, and CI/CD tools.
* Strong understanding of security & access management – JWT, OAuth, RBAC – and secure API communication.

**Additional Information**
**Set Yourself Apart With:**

* Prior work on GenAI, CoPilot, or RAG-based systems.
* Familiarity with marketing data models and real-time customer journeys.
* Exposure to NLP, LLMs, and retrieval frameworks beyond the core requirements above.

**A Tip from the Hiring Manager:**
“AI is evolving fast – join us to work hands-on with big clients, sharpen your skills, and stay future-ready.
  
  
**Benefits of Working Here:**

* Gender-Neutral Policy
* 18 paid holidays throughout the year.
* Generous parental leave and new parent transition program
* Flexible work arrangements
* Employee Assistance Programs to help you in wellness and well-being.

**Company Description**
Publicis Sapient is a digital transformation partner helping established organizations get to their future, digitally enabled state, both in the way they work and the way they serve their customers. We help unlock value through a start-up mindset and modern methods, fusing strategy, consulting, and customer experience with agile engineering and problem-solving creativity. United by our core values and our purpose of helping people thrive in the brave pursuit of next, our 20,000+ people in 53 offices around the world combine experience across technology, data sciences, consulting, and customer obsession to accelerate our clients’ businesses through designing the products and services their customers truly value.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer IRC302349
description:
**Description**
**About the Role & Team**
We are seeking a Forward-Deployed AI Architect to help our enterprise customers radically accelerate and modernize their software delivery lifecycle. In this elite, high-impact role, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to prove the value of AI-led engineering through hands-on architecture, agentic workflows, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  
  
This role is designed for senior architects and builders who sit at the intersection of core enterprise software architecture and cutting-edge AI engineering. You will help customers transition from traditional, ticket-bound Scrum cycles toward intent-driven, increasingly autonomous delivery models where AI tools, agents, and human governance seamlessly turn business intent into production-ready software.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Candidate Profile: Qualifications & Experience**
**Must-Have Attributes**
– Experience: 12+ years of proven experience across software engineering, architecture, product/platform engineering, or solution architecture, backed by a strong track record of product-side delivery.
  
  
– SDLC Mastery: Deep, foundational understanding of enterprise software architecture, DevSecOps pipelines, Agile/Scrum frameworks, and the broader product lifecycle.
  
  
– Hands-on AI Fluency: Direct, practical fluency with AI development tools, IDE-based AI assistants, agentic workflows, and AI-enabled software delivery. You must possess the ability to build, evaluate, and deeply explain working AI solutions.
  
  
– Modern AI Tech Stack: Experience leveraging tools and frameworks such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, LangChain, AutoGen, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, MCP (Model Context Protocol), RAG, and vector databases.
  
  
– Hands on in Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Databases, Evaluation Frameworks, Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, Function Calling, Multi-agent orchestration, AI Observability
  
  
**Good-to-Have Skills**
– Customer-Facing Excellence: Prior experience in high-touch, customer-facing technical roles (e.g., Forward-Deployed Engineer, Principal Solutions Architect, Field Engineer, or Pre-Sales Engineering Leader).
  
  
– AI Governance & Security: A strong grasp of AI governance models, human-in-the-loop controls, responsible AI frameworks, observability, and production readiness for AI-enabled enterprise systems.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client Engagement & Strategic Architecture

– Identify AI Opportunities: Work directly with customer engineering, product, architecture, and executive teams to diagnose SDLC bottlenecks and map out high-value areas for AI-led acceleration.
  
  
– Design & Build Proofs of Concept: Act as a hands-on builder to design, develop, and deliver working proofs utilizing modern AI engineering tools, agentic workflows, and automation frameworks.
  
  
– Lead the Intent-Driven Transition: Guide clients away from rigid, manual sprint mechanics toward fluid, intent-driven delivery loops capable of autonomously generating plans, code, tests, documentation, and validation artifacts.
  
  
  

* Value Measurement & Executive Alignment

– Quantify AI Impact: Define, measure, and report on hard engineering acceleration outcomes, including reduced cycle times, faster story-to-code conversion, improved automated testing, and accelerated code reviews.
  
  
– Technical & Executive Presentation: Communicate complex technical approaches, agentic architectures, proof results, and long-term adoption strategies to both engineering teams and C-level stakeholders.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
**Exciting Projects:**
We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
  
  
**Collaborative Environment:**
You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
  
  
**Work-Life Balance:**
GlobalLogic prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
  
  
**Excellent Benefits:**
We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
  
  
**Fun Perks:**
We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
  
  
**About GlobalLogic**
GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

title: AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability
description:
Join us as a "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability" at Barclays, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behavior, and deliver content direct to users of information products. You will work with technical teams, architects, designers, and administrators to overcome technical challenges and to make it happen. You will need to take ownership of key initiatives to deliver results through an agile workflow.
  
  
You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
To be successful as an "AVP - Cloud Adoption & Scalability", you should have experience with:
  
  
**Essential Skills And Qualifications**

* Manage change to data platforms.
* Perform incident triage for platform issues.
* Perform root cause analysis on platform performance issues.
* Manage cloud platform usage and costs.
* Educate on the data platforms that are used across the businesses.
* Support users in accessing the platforms and adhering to the required governance.
* Advocate best practice for data platform use to maximize business value delivered.
* Identify common themes in user platform use that is sub optimal and implement training and / or support where needed.
* Championing the features that the business need.
* Translating complex technology into consumable business language. Supporting corporate data modernisation program.
* Design, test and build complex forecast models and simulations to identify causal links between customer behavior and business opportunities and performance.

**Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications**

* Communication
* Problem solving
* SQL
* Database query optimization (and understanding of if and when optimization techniques can be used on different platforms)
* Willingness to learn new tools and platforms and then help educate others.

This role will be based out of Gurugram.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To enable data-driven strategic and operational decision making through extracting actionable insights from large datasets, performing statistical and advanced analytics to uncover trends and patterns, and presenting findings through clear visualisations and reports.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Investigation and analysis of data issues related to quality, lineage, controls, and authoritative source identification, documenting data sources, methodologies, and quality findings with recommendations for improvement.
* Designing and building data pipelines to automate data movement and processing.
* Apply advanced analytical techniques to large datasets to uncover trends and correlations, develop validated logical data models, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations that drive operational and process improvements, leveraging machine learning/AI.
* Through data-driven analysis, translate analytical findings into actionable business recommendations, identifying opportunities for operational and process improvements.
* Design and create interactive dashboards and visual reports using applicable tools and automate reporting processes for regular and ad-hoc stakeholder needs.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Principal Manager, Tech (GAITech)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
We are looking for an engineering manager to join our GAI Tech “Strike” team at the D. E. Shaw India office based in Hyderabad, Bengaluru, or Gurugram. The GAI Tech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of the GAI Tech team will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAI Tech's role focuses on user education and promoting inter-departmental collaboration. The mission of GAI Tech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development which includes AI-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAI Tech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready-to-use applications for developers. Embracing open-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAI Tech's objectives, thereby supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques. While the GAI Tech team is a research and development (R&D) group responsible for the development of firmwide GAI tech applications, the “Strike” team is a new sub team within GAI Tech that will work closely with groups across the firm to both, consult on ideas, and provide resources to directly implement the highest value projects.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will be working on overseeing the end-to-end development of generative AI applications for the group you are working with. You will exhibit excellent learning agility to be able to work with a varied set of groups in a time-bound fashion and showcase excellent judgement in devising and implementing solutions for group-wide needs. You will be expected to exhibit a consultant’s mindset, be able to learn the group’s setup very well, propose the right solutions for their needs, solve complex technical challenges, ensure project specifications are met efficiently, and facilitate the rapid learning and implementation of new technologies within the group. Furthermore, you will also be expected to exhibit excellent productivity and demonstrate exceptional, and clear communication skills. You will manage and lead the team to ensure a productive working environment and clear communication. You will also lead the team on its goals, the focus will be on improving areas including developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, promoting generative AI for BU-specific adoption, etc. People and project management is going to be a key part of the job role.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
**Basic qualifications:**

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical field with 10 to 16 years of relevant industry work experience
* Proficiency in Python with robust coding and debugging abilities
* Exceptional problem-solving abilities and the capacity to acquire and apply new technologies quickly
* Prior exposure to GAI projects and frameworks
* At least 1 year of people and team management experience, leading a team of at least 2 members
* Robust interpersonal and stakeholder management skills along with effective written and verbal communication abilities

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in managing and working in a global and diverse team
* GAI academic qualifications/certifications

Interested candidates can apply through our website:
  
  
https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Adv/Link/PrnMgrGAITechOct25

title: Associate, Grid, PI - Global Capability Center
description:

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. Our Performance Improvement team provides Business Transformation and Performance Improvement Services to Corporates, Investors, and their portfolio companies, delivering –
  
  

* Performance improvement via cost reduction and revenue growth programmes
* Large, complex organizational restructuring and business transformation
* Rapid Results Program, which helps to quickly and effectively assess business process management risks and identify key areas impeding performance

Our GRID Product Provides Hyperlocal Geospatial Intelligence Solution That Supports Various Industries Like Telecom, Retail, Healthcare, Travel & Logistics In Making Data-backed, Intelligent Decisions. GRID Brings Together Both Functional Expertise And Scalable Tech Stack For
  
  

* Site-level intelligence on asset supply coverage and user experience (for both client and competitors)
* Advanced Analytics platform for scenario modelling and optimization algorithms
* Enhanced real-time visualization and collaboration, distributed across the client org (assets, strategy, marketing etc.)
* Working with cross-functional teams using a ‘single source of truth’ that aligns customer “demand” data and asset “supply” data

We are seeking an experienced and innovative Associate with a proven track record in developing new products & managing product-led consulting delivery, leveraging Geospatial Analytics as part of our GRID team. This role involves overseeing the development, analysis, and application of geospatial data to drive strategic decision-making for our corporate and private equity clients. The ideal candidate will combine technical expertise in geospatial analytics with strong project management skills to deliver impactful solutions across various domains such as CAPEX Optimization, Go-to-market, Cost to serve, Market Attractiveness, White space opportunity, Competitive intensity etc. across multiple industries with focus on Telecom (Fiber, Tower and Data Centre), Retail, Healthcare, Travel and Hospitality etc.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Building a high performing global centre of excellence for geospatial analytics within Performance Improvement Practice
* Executing the collection, processing, and analysis of geospatial data using advanced GIS tools and methodologies
* Develop and maintain geospatial databases to ensure data integrity and accuracy
* Contribute to the creation of high-quality maps and visualizations that effectively communicate data insights
* Support senior analysts in conducting spatial analyses and modelling
* Assist in implementing spatial analysis techniques such as distance calculations and spatial overlays
* Assist in managing GIS projects across various disciplines, ensuring timely delivery and quality standards
* Participate in training sessions and workshops to enhance technical skills in geospatial technologies
* Position A&M Global Capability Center as a thought partner within the firm for building new solutions and offerings

**Qualifications**

* Comes with 1-5 years of relevant hands-on experience working with a global consulting firm, delivering geospatial driven analytics consulting services delivery for corporate and PE clients
* MBA or Master’s from a top-tier institute
* Have strong knowledge on various spatial models and algorithms to solve complex problems
* Proficiency in solutions around Geo Spatial Analytics (custom solutions, scenario modelling, large volume rendering, foot traffic, shape file formats)
* Proficiency in technical skills
* Python (Geospatial libraries like geopandas), SQL, Alteryx
* Visualization tools (ArcGIS, QGIS, PowerBI, CARTO)
* Statistical Analysis methodologies (Gradient Boost, Random Forest)
* Microsoft Office Suite (must have)
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Strong analytical, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team environment

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Research Associate / Sr Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
description:
Title: Research Associate / Senior Research Associate (Heat Forecast)
  
  
Location: Delhi, India preferred. Applicants must hold Indian citizenship and valid authorization to work in India. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications from OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholders for this role.
  
  
Salary: Salary will be competitive and commensurate with the candidate's skills, experience, and the local labor market in India.
  
  
Position: Full-time
  
  
Application deadline: Nov 10, 2026, at 5 pm IST (applications may be reviewed as they are submitted)
  
  
**About The Role**
Precision Development (PxD) is looking for a Research Associate / Senior Research Associate to join our weather initiative in India. The successful candidate will lead formative research on how AI-based heat forecasts can help agriculture and livestock farmers prepare for and respond to heat. Working closely with PxD and affiliated researchers, they will help define a concrete heat-advisory use case and pilot it with farmers and government partners — testing new ideas and measuring their impact.
  
  
The role calls for someone who is curious about how farmers make decisions under climate risk, comfortable moving between fieldwork and data, and who understands how digital technology is adopted and scaled within government.
  
  
If you're passionate about turning advances in AI weather forecasting into practical, evidence-based services for farmers, and committed to driving positive change in the agricultural sector, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
We're hiring for this role at either the Research Associate or Senior Research Associate level. The specific level will be determined based on the candidate's years of experience, demonstrated seniority, and scope of past responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
These will evolve as the role develops; key initial areas are outlined below.
  
  
Formative Research
  
  

* Design and conduct formative research (qualitative interviews, focus group discussions, rapid surveys) with crop and livestock farmers to understand how extreme heat affects their livelihoods, decisions, and coping strategies
* Map farmers' current sources of weather information, the timing and lead time they need, and the actions they could take in response to a heat forecast.
* Engage with government agencies, meteorological departments, extension systems, and livestock/veterinary services to understand existing heat early-warning systems and gaps
* Review literature and existing evidence on heat-stress impacts and heat early-warning interventions in agriculture and livestock
* Synthesize findings into clear research briefs and presentations for internal teams and partners.

Use Case Definition & Design
  
  

* Translate formative research insights into a well-defined use case for AI-based heat forecasts, specifying target users, decisions supported, forecast variables, lead times, and thresholds
* Work with data science and forecasting partners to assess the skill and suitability of AI-based heat forecast products for the target geographies
* Co-design heat advisory content and delivery channels with farmers, agronomists, and livestock experts

Data & Analysis
  
  

* Design and program survey instruments (SurveyCTO/ODK)
* Oversee data collection quality, including field visits, back-checks, and high-frequency checks
* Analyze pilot data on farmer engagement, comprehension, trust, behavior change, and early outcomes
* Clean, merge, and analyze weather, forecast, survey, and administrative data (Stata, R, or Python)
* Assess the relationship between heat exposure and agricultural and livestock outcomes using existing data where available
* Monitor forecast performance against observed weather data and flag issues to technical partners
* Contribute to dashboards and data pipelines supporting PxD's weather initiative, as needed

What You'll Bring
  
  

* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in economics, agricultural economics, public policy, development studies, statistics, environmental/climate science, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated experience conducting field research in LMIC settings, including qualitative methods (interviews, FGDs) and quantitative surveys
* Strong understanding of economics and econometrics, and familiarity with randomized evaluations
* Excellent knowledge of Stata, R, Python, or similar software for data analysis
* Demonstrated experience using SurveyCTO/ODK or a similar program for survey design
* Understanding of research ethics for human subjects in the social sciences
* Interest in climate adaptation, weather and climate services, or digital agriculture; familiarity with weather/forecast data or heat-stress impacts on crops or livestock is a strong plus
* Ability to translate research insights into practical product or service design, working with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Excellent organizational skills, detail-oriented, and ability to work both independently and collaboratively
* Fluency in English with strong oral and written communication skills; knowledge of Hindi or another Indian language is a plus
* Ability to work under time pressure and solve problems creatively
* Willingness to travel frequently to project sites and conduct fieldwork, including during summer months

How to Apply
  
  
To apply, please visit the PxD website and use the online application form to submit a CV, cover letter, and brief responses to the screening questions. Applications may be reviewed on a rolling basis. The final deadline to apply is 10 November 2026, 5 pm IST.
  
  
In line with our values, we evaluate candidates on merit alone, without regard to gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, disability, caste, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. We offer flexible working arrangements to support your wellbeing. Personal data provided is used for recruitment purposes only.
  
  
**About Precision Development (PxD)**
PxD is a rapidly scaling global nonprofit working with governments across Africa and Asia to close the last-mile gap in smallholder farming. We deliver evidence-based information and tools — from timely farming and weather guidance to climate-resilient inputs — that millions of farmers use to improve their lives. In the last 12 months alone, we reached over 60 million farmers at a cost of just $0.47 per farmer per year, with our flagship program in India delivering a benefit-cost ratio of 12:1–19:1.
  
  
Operating in Ethiopia, India, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, and beyond, the majority of our team is based in our program countries, working directly alongside government partners and farming communities toward our goal of improving the lives of 100 million farmers by 2030.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:

**About Company**

A venture-backed, stealth-stage startup reimagining how people connect. The company is building a next-generation matchmaking platform where AI, community, and content come together.

At its core is a real-time ML recommendation engine delivering deeply personalised experiences — even in sparse data scenarios. Backed by marquee VCs in India and the US, the company has raised $10M+ at seed stage.

The team of 23 operates with the urgency and autonomy of a founding-stage environment. Founders bring extensive experience launching and scaling dating apps and global consumer internet businesses.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and own end-to-end matchmaking, recommendation, ranking, and personalisation systems
* Develop a real-time adaptive matchmaking engine that learns continuously from user interactions and behavioural signals
* Build user embedding systems, similarity models, and graph-based match scoring frameworks
* Architect and implement cold-start solutions to deliver quality recommendations for new users with sparse data
* Deploy models to production with fast iteration loops, model registries, and observability tooling
* Define and track offline and online evaluation frameworks, A/B tests, and metric alignment across the recommendation stack
* Partner with Data, Product, and Backend teams to translate business goals into scalable ML solutions

**Must Have Criteria**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience building personalisation, recommendation, ranking, or search systems at scale
* Prior experience at a B2C product company or startup — social, e-commerce, fashion, gaming, dating, or video platforms
* Working knowledge of collaborative filtering, two-tower deep retrieval models, learning-to-rank, and embedding-based ANN search
* End-to-end ML pipeline ownership — both training models and deploying them to production
* Familiarity with offline and online evaluation methodologies, A/B testing, and metric alignment

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with vector search, graph-based algorithms, or LLM-based approaches for sparse data personalisation
* Prior ownership or leadership of a recsys, feed ranking, or search initiative
* Exposure to cold-start problem-solving in low-data or new-user scenarios
* Background at a high-scale B2C product or consumer startup

**What We Offer**

* Direct ownership of systems that are core to the product — not peripheral tooling
* Autonomy to shape ML architecture and infrastructure from the ground up
* Collaborative, experimentation-driven culture with responsive, growth-oriented founders

description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Apply structured, hypothesis-driven problem solving to translate business questions into analytical approaches and clear insights
* Analyze complex, multi-source healthcare data to identify trends, drivers, and opportunities for improvement across cost, quality, and growth
* Synthesize findings into clear, decision-ready recommendations with a solid "so what" and quantified business impact
* Partner with stakeholders in a matrixed COE environment to shape problem statements, align on priorities, and drive adoption of insights
* Communicate insights through compelling storytelling tailored to executive and operational audiences
* Identify and prioritize opportunities for optimization
* Support end-to-end analytical delivery, including data exploration, feature engineering, model development (as applicable), and results interpretation
* Collaborate with data engineering and data platform teams to ensure data availability, quality, and usability for analytics use cases
* Contribute to development of reusable analytical assets, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across the COE
* Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, reliable, and aligned to business context, with clear assumptions and limitations
* Continuously improve analytic approaches, streamline processes, and reduce low-value or redundant work
* Support the development of data-driven decision making by educating stakeholders and promoting evidence-based practices
* Works with less structured, more complex issues
* Serves as a resource to others
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in analytics, statistics, economics, engineering, computer science, or related field
* 6+ years of experience in analytics, strategy, or data-driven problem solving
* Experience working with large, complex datasets including data extraction, transformation, and analysis (SQL, Python, or similar tools)
* Experience translating data into insights and recommendations for business or operational stakeholders
* Experience communicating findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience working in a cross-functional, matrixed environment
* Proven solid analytical thinking with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and identify key drivers

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare analytics (claims, financial, or operational data)
* Experience building dashboards or data products (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)
* Experience identifying and quantifying business impact (ROI, cost savings, revenue growth)
* Exposure to cloud-based data and analytics platforms and infra services. (Azure, Databricks, etc.)
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive adoption of recommendations
* Demonstrated solid storytelling and presentation skills, particularly for executive audiences
* Demonstrated desire to continuously learn, challenge assumptions, and improve how analytics drives business outcomes

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone - of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income - deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Deployment Intern - Computer Vision
description:
**Internship Duration**
: 3–4 months, with the possibility of a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO).

**Stipend:**

₹20,000–₹30,000 per month, depending on interview performance

**Location:**

Fully on-site, Delhi NCR

**You’ll work directly with:**

The founder

**About Guardex**

Guardex builds AI video intelligence for factories using their existing CCTV cameras. Our systems help factory teams monitor operations, safety, compliance, and security through camera-based alerts and dashboards.

We’re looking for a hands-on intern to help take deployments from client requirements through camera configuration, testing, and rollout. The role combines computer vision skills, practical problem solving, and some client interaction.

**What you’ll do**

1. **Understand client requirements**

* Join deployment and review calls, and clarify requirements with the client when needed.
* Convert discussions into a clear camera-wise plan: use cases, zones, operating hours, thresholds, and other parameters.
* Document requirements and changes so the deployment team knows what to configure.

1. **Configure and support deployments**

* Map use cases and settings to the correct cameras.
* Help apply configuration changes through Guardex’s ops panel and check that they reach the right deployment.
* Support testing and rollout at client sites.

1. **Computer vision skills to deployments**

* Help deploy and configure computer vision pipelines for factory use cases.
* Use your knowledge of YOLO, OpenCV, model fine-tuning, and inference optimisation to help adapt deployments to real factory conditions.

1. **Support deployment tooling**

* Help with Docker-based deployments and related configuration as Guardex’s deployment tools grow.
* Work with the team to make deployments and updates more consistent and easier to manage.

**What we’re looking for**

* Practical computer vision knowledge, including
  **YOLO, OpenCV, model fine-tuning, and inference optimisation**

  .
* Ability to investigate detection errors and reason through false positives and missed detections.
* Familiarity with model training workflows and data preparation; knowledge distillation experience is a plus.
* A strong problem-solving mindset: you can break down an unclear issue, test possible causes, and follow through.
* Clear, organised communication. You should be comfortable explaining requirements, findings, and next steps to clients and teammates.
* A proactive, hands-on approach, you notice what needs attention and take ownership of it.
* Willingness to interact with clients during requirement gathering, deployment checks, and issue resolution.
* Familiarity with Linux and Docker is useful; deeper DevOps experience is a plus.

**Working style**

This is a
**fully on-site internship**

. You’ll work directly with the founder and closely with the deployment and engineering teams. It’s suited to someone who enjoys applying computer vision to practical deployment problems, communicating clearly, and taking ownership of getting things done.

Interested candidates can share their resume at info@guardex.ai

title: Manager, AI Platform Engineer, DTS - Global Capability Center
description:
**Description**
**About Alvarez & Marsal**
Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work - guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity - are why our people love working at A&M.
  
  
**The Team**
**Our DTS Team Provides Following Services To Clients**

* Data & Applied Intelligence - Helping clients in harnessing the power of data and cutting-edge analytics to drive intelligent decision-making and transform businesses.
* Product and Innovation - Empowering clients to innovate, develop, and launch products that drives growth and competitive advantage.
* Technology M&A and Strategy - Assist clients to manage the technology aspects and business enablement of complex M&A, integrations and carve-outs.
* Technology Transformation - A&M helps clients create a scalable, cost-effective IT function that delivers the company's strategic vision and priorities.

**How You Will Contribute**

* Build the evaluation framework used to determine whether an AI application is fit to go live, covering component, trajectory and end-to-end outcome measurement, with defined pass thresholds integrated into the delivery pipeline.
* Work directly with business subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and convert them into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Design and calibrate automated judging, validating it against human review so that reported scores are meaningful and defensible.
* Own repeatable adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, guardrail bypass and data leakage, and rerun the suite after every material model or prompt change.
* Implement runtime safety controls, including content filtering, sensitive-data redaction, tool permissions, spend caps and circuit breakers.
* Instrument applications so quality, latency, tokens and model cost are observable per request, application and tenant.
* Own model-cost optimisation through routing, caching and prompt efficiency, using evaluation evidence to demonstrate when a lower-cost model is sufficient.
* Monitor production quality and drift, maintain a failure taxonomy, and feed observed failures back into benchmark datasets.
* Validate model upgrades before cutover so vendor model changes do not degrade client-facing systems.

**Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in software, data or AI/ML engineering, with strong Python capability and hands-on experience building production-grade agentic or LLM applications for real users using LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, tool calling and retrieval.
* Demonstrable experience designing AI evaluations and measuring retrieval quality, including defining measures and scoring methods, assessing groundedness and relevance, diagnosing failures, distinguishing genuine regressions from noise, and running online evaluations over sampled production traces.
* Practical experience implementing model-safety controls and adversarial testing, including prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, data leakage, filtering, redaction, guardrails, spend limits and loop controls.
* Experience accessing and deploying models across multiple providers, understanding cost, latency and capability trade-offs, and working with self-hosted or open-weight models, fine-tuning, distillation or prompt optimisation.
* Consulting or client-facing delivery experience, including the ability to work with non-technical subject-matter experts to define correct outcomes and translate their judgement into maintained benchmark datasets.
* Hands-on OpenTelemetry instrumentation for nested, multi-step agents, including tool-call spans, session and conversation tracing, trace-context propagation across asynchronous workers and queues, and correlation IDs through background processing.
* Experience with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix or Weights & Biases Weave; integration with platforms such as Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, Grafana or Datadog; and structured telemetry for token usage, latency and cost by request, application and tenant.

**Your journey at A&M**
We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top-notch training and on-the-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career. We prioritize your well-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A&M. The possibilities are endless for high-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Senior Analyst, Lending Models
description:
**About Allica Bank**
Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.
  
  
Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.
  
  
**Department Description**
The Modelling team sits within the Credit Portfolio Management (CPM) function and is at the heart of building the measurement and decisioning models behind Allica’s lending products. The team builds and owns the bank’s IFRS9 model estate (including PD, LGD, SICR and economic response models), the statistical and machine learning models and credit policy rules used for automated underwriting, and the credit-linked GenAI solutions used to automate processes.
  
  
**Role Description**
This role will be part of the team building, implementing, monitoring and optimising two sets of models: the IFRS9 impairment models that measure our credit risk and support accurate reporting to auditors and investors, and the decisioning models and policy rules behind automated lending, which are critical to delivering fast, consistent and well-controlled credit decisions and a better customer journey as the bank grows.
  
  
The role requires the technical ability and practical mindset to take models and decisioning changes from initial problem definition through data identification, cleansing and analysis to model development, implementation and ongoing monitoring. The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between structured model development and fast-paced ad-hoc analysis, working closely with Finance, Credit Risk, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data, Engineering, Capital Markets and Model Risk colleagues. They will communicate complex concepts clearly to stakeholders with different levels of technical expertise and work with third-party suppliers where required. We are looking for a hands-on modeller who can turn data into reliable, scalable solutions, and help make data a key strength for the bank.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**

* Take a hands-on role in the design, build, implementation and continuous refinement of the bank’s credit risk models, spanning the full suite of IFRS9 impairment models (PD, LGD, SICR and economic response) and the statistical and machine learning models that support automated lending decisions.
* Develop and deploy models in Python across the full model lifecycle, including data preparation, feature engineering, model fitting, validation, implementation and ongoing performance assessment.
* Perform ad-hoc analysis to optimise credit policy rules and decisioning flows, using rule-firing, decision and outcome data to identify redundant, overlapping or mis-calibrated rules.
* Produce regular monitoring, covering population stability, discriminatory power, calibration, and segment and vintage performance, as well as decision rates and alignment with underwriting outcomes for decisioning models.
* Recalibrate or redevelop models as portfolio experience matures, comparing predicted and actual outcomes and adjusting model scaling, score cut-offs or policy thresholds where evidence of drift or mis-calibration exists.
* Lead root-cause investigations into model, rule or decisioning-flow underperformance by tracing issues through decision logs, data lineage, feature calculations, production pipelines and implementation logic.
* Build well-controlled, reproducible modelling processes and drive improvements to the data, tooling and infrastructure required for future model development and deployment.
* Document models, rules, assumptions, limitations and changes to a high standard, supporting governance, independent review and validation, and stakeholder review.
* Work closely with Credit Risk, Finance, Underwriting, Collections, Product, Data and Engineering teams to track model requirements and translate business needs into practical solutions, while complying with all mandatory policies and maintaining a strong internal control environment.

**Personal Attributes & Experience**

* You have at least 5 years’ hands-on risk modelling experience, applying statistical modelling techniques such as logistic and linear regression, as well as machine learning models, to solve practical business problems.
* You are comfortable with large data sets, and data extraction and manipulation using Excel, SQL, Python & BI tools.
* You have a proven track record with Python coding, and are comfortable using GenAI tools to increase coding productivity.
* You have a good understanding of IFRS9, credit and lending concepts, preferably in commercial lending.
* You are driven, self-motivated and passionate about building great solutions for the bank.
* You can work independently and are flexible to adapt quickly to changing priorities within a very dynamic environment.
* You work well with stakeholders across the business, and collaboratively within the team.
* You have strong skills in writing technical documents as well as business-focused documents to get buy-in from various stakeholders.
* Experience of implementation of models into software applications is highly desirable.

Prior experience in this area matters for this role. If you believe you are a strong fit for the role, but don’t quite meet one of the requirements above – if you think you can suitably overcome that, then please apply anyway.
  
  
**Working at Allica Bank**
At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.
  
  
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:
  
  

* Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities
* Options for flexible working
* Regular social activities
* Pension contributions
* Discretionary bonus scheme
* Private health cover
* Life assurance
* Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

**Don’t tick every box?**
Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!
  
  
**Flexible working**
We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.
  
  
**Diversity**
We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: Senior Director AI/ML Engineering
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
An SG31 Senior Director, AI/ML Engineering is a senior technology executive responsible for leading enterprise AI initiatives from strategy through execution and value realization. The role provides leadership for AI engineering organizations and serves as the accountable owner for AI platforms, intelligent automation capabilities, machine learning solutions, and emerging AI technologies that support business transformation. The position focuses on delivering measurable business outcomes through AI while ensuring scalability, reliability, security, and governance.
  
  
The Senior Director is responsible for setting the technical and business direction for AI programs, establishing multi-year roadmaps, prioritizing investments, and aligning technology execution with organizational goals. They work closely with business leaders, product teams, operations partners, architecture groups, and executive leadership to identify opportunities where AI can improve efficiency, reduce cost, enhance customer experiences, and create new capabilities. Success is measured not only by technology delivery but also by adoption, operational impact, productivity gains, and financial value creation.
  
  
As a people leader, the role oversees a team of engineering leaders, AI engineers, machine learning engineers, data scientists, and platform specialists distributed across onshore and offshore locations. Responsibilities include organizational design, talent strategy, workforce planning, hiring, performance management, leadership development, and succession planning. The Senior Director creates an environment of innovation, accountability, continuous learning, and engineering excellence while building a solid leadership bench capable of scaling enterprise AI capabilities.
  
  
From a technology perspective, this leader owns the end-to-end lifecycle of AI solutions, including platform architecture, model deployment, intelligent agents, automation frameworks, cloud infrastructure, production operations, observability, and reliability engineering. The role ensures that AI capabilities are developed as reusable enterprise assets rather than isolated solutions, enabling faster adoption and greater return on investment across multiple business domains.
  
  
The position carries significant accountability for Responsible AI, compliance, security, and risk management. The Senior Director ensures that all AI solutions comply with governance requirements, regulatory obligations, ethical AI principles, privacy standards, and operational controls. They establish processes for model monitoring, performance measurement, incident management, human oversight, and continuous improvement to maintain trust and reliability at enterprise scale.
  
  
The role requires solid executive presence and the ability to influence senior leaders across the organization. The Senior Director regularly communicates strategy, progress, risks, investment needs, and business outcomes to executives while building alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. They act as the bridge between technology and business organizations, ensuring that AI investments are translated into meaningful operational and financial results.
  
  
Ultimately, an SG31 Senior Director, AI/ML Engineering is expected to provide broad organizational leadership, own enterprise-scale AI platforms and programs, drive adoption and value realization, build high-performing teams, ensure governance and operational excellence, and serve as the accountable leader for delivering transformative AI capabilities that advance the organization's strategic objectives.
  
  
**Primary Responsibility**

* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related technical field
* 15+ years of technology and software engineering experience, including at least 8-10 years of leadership experience managing engineering organizations
* Experience leading enterprise-scale AI platforms, MLOps, AI governance frameworks, model deployment, observability, and production operations
* Experience developing senior leaders, driving organizational transformation, managing talent strategies, workforce planning, succession planning, and building high-performing engineering cultures
* Experience translating business strategy into technology roadmaps and investment priorities
* Experience establishing and operating AI governance frameworks, Responsible AI practices, model risk management processes, security controls, compliance requirements, and audit readiness
* Experience partnering with CIOs, business executives, product leaders, operations leaders, and external partners
* Solid understanding of financial management, budgeting, business case development, operational metrics, and technology investment governance.
* Deep understanding of Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI, Natural Language Processing, Generative AI, intelligent automation, cloud platforms, and modern software engineering practices
* Proven track record of building and scaling enterprise AI/ML solutions, leading large engineering teams, and delivering measurable business outcomes through AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives
* Demonstrated success leading multi-functional teams across onshore and offshore locations
* Exceptional communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills
* Proven ability to manage complex portfolios, prioritize competing demands, drive value realization, and communicate effectively with executive leadership
* Demonstrated ability to present strategy, roadmap, business value, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership and executive committees
* Demonstrated ability to inspire teams while maintaining solid accountability for execution and results
* Demonstrated ability to balance innovation with enterprise governance, regulatory obligations, privacy requirements, and operational risk management

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering Management, or Business Administration
* Ph.D. in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related discipline is advantageous for highly specialized AI leadership roles
* Industry certifications such as Microsoft Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, SAFe Agilist, PMP, TOGAF, Certified Scrum Professional, or other AI, cloud, architecture, and leadership certifications
* Solid knowledge of Azure AI services, APIs, distributed systems, and platform engineering

**Key Competencies**
Strategic thinking, enterprise leadership, AI innovation, platform ownership, product mindset, organizational design, talent development, executive communication, stakeholder influence, financial stewardship, operational excellence, governance leadership, and business outcome accountability.
  
  
**Ideal SG31 Profile**
An executive-level AI leader who can build and scale enterprise AI platforms, lead large engineering organizations, influence senior leadership, govern AI responsibly, and deliver measurable business value through adoption, automation, productivity improvements, cost savings, and transformational AI capabilities.
