title: Founding ML Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
ML at Optifye has been founder-run from day one. You will own it completely. You will own the full ML lifecycle: the data engine, training, evaluation, deployment to production, monitoring in the wild, and the loop that ties them together. Real factories are the hardest possible environment for computer vision: bad lighting, blocked views, camera angles you didn't choose, hundreds of subtly different processes and your models have to be right, in real time, with customers watching. Applied-first, with genuine research depth. You've trained models yourself, not orchestrated APIs, and you've also carried them all the way into production and lived with the consequences. You read papers, implement the ones that matter, and know when the frontier idea beats the boring baseline and when it doesn't. Requirements: - You've owned an ML system end-to-end in production: data, training, evals, deployment, monitoring and iterated it against real-world failure, not benchmark leaderboards. - Deep computer vision fundamentals: you can reason from first principles about why a model fails on real video, and design the data or architecture change that fixes it. - You've built or run a serious data engine collecting data, deciding what to label, hunting down the hard examples, building test sets that actually predict real-world performance. - You did your best work at an early seat in a high-performing startup: small team, no safety net, outcomes on you. - Evidence of exceptional work anywhere: published research with real impact, a system people said couldn't be built, a result that made your previous team's product possible. Company Summary Optifye is an AI performance monitoring system for factory workers backed by Y Combinator. We put cameras in factories and use computer vision to find shop floor inefficiencies in real-time. Our clients are industry-leading manufacturers in the garments, automotive, medical, and FMCG industries across the world. We are one of the fastest-growing B2B startups in India. Going from 0 - $25M in 9 months. The shop floor has historically been a black box. With Optifye, manufacturing companies can now accurately measure worker output and boost efficiency! Why Join Us It's going to be brutal, you're going to have a lot of work, but once the dust settles, you will have higher returns than everyone around you.

title: Lead Operations Researcher
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Praxas AI is the AI-native decision layer for supply chains. We sit on top of the ERP a company already runs and continuously re-optimize what to make, stock, buy and ship as conditions change helping four primary departments: sourcing, inventory, production planning and logistics. When a supplier slips or a rush order lands, Praxas recommends the response (accelerate a PO, delay a production run, adjust safety stock), and our agents carry it out with Human-on-the-loop approval, , with the long term goal shifting to Human-in-the-loop approval.

**The Opportunity**

We're hiring our first Operations Research Engineer to own the math behind every Praxas decision. You'll build the optimization engine for production planning first, then inventory, sourcing and logistics.

This is a hands-on build role, not academic research or consulting. You'll turn messy factory realities (capacities, changeovers, bills of materials, late suppliers) into models that run on real customer data and re-plan continuously. You'll move between a planner's desk on a factory floor, a solver log and a whiteboard with our engineers without losing the thread.

Our principle is simple: the solver decides, the AI explains and acts. You own the solver. You'll work directly with the founders, our AI and data engineers, and the planners who use what you build every day.

**What You Will Do**

**Build the decision engine**

• Model real plants: capacities, routings, bills of materials, changeovers, labor, material availability and due dates.

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling problems (lot sizing, sequencing, capacity allocation) that minimize lost sales and cost.

• Pick the right method for each problem: mixed-integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics or decomposition.

• Keep solve times fast enough to re-plan on demand for plants with hundreds of products.

• Design models that are configured per customer (industry, production type, demand pattern), not rewritten per customer.

**Make re-optimization continuous and trustworthy**

• Build rolling-horizon re-planning that reacts to new orders, delays and breakdowns without reshuffling the whole plan.

• Use time fences, frozen windows and change penalties so planners can trust the schedule.

• Turn the trade-off between optimality and stability into a setting planners understand.

• Model uncertainty in demand, lead times and yields with stochastic or robust approaches.

**Extend into inventory optimization and forecasting**

• Build inventory optimization: safety stock, reorder points, service-level targets and multi-location policies.

• Use probabilistic forecasts (ranges, not single numbers) as optimizer inputs, working with our forecasting engine.

• Backtest every model against customer history before it touches a live plan.

Ship with customers and the team

• Work directly with planners and plant heads at our design partners to validate constraints and results.

• Feed our AI agents the decisions they act on: delay a production run, expedite a PO, adjust safety stock.

• Tell our data engineers exactly what data each model needs, and how to handle missing or messy inputs.

• Define and track the metrics that prove value: lost sales avoided, inventory freed, on-time-in-full and machine utilization.

**What Success Looks Like**

**In the first 90 days**

• Ship v1 of the production planning model, running on real data from our first design partners.

• Set a baseline for each partner: current lost sales, utilization, changeover time and plan versus actual.

• Agree solve-time and plan-stability targets with the team, and meet them on partner data.

• Document every model's formulation, assumptions and parameters so others can extend it.

**Within 6–12 months**

• Run continuous re-optimization in production for every customer, with stability controls planners trust.

• Deliver results customers sign off on: fewer lost sales, less excess inventory and better on-time-in-full.

• Connect inventory optimization and probabilistic forecasts to production planning in one engine.

• Build reusable model templates by production type (job shop, batch, assembly, continuous) to cut implementation time.

• Own the operations research roadmap, and help hire and mentor as the team grows.

**Who You Are**

**Required**

• Operations research and advanced modeling: design and implement advanced analytical models using techniques such as mixed-integer linear programming, discrete event simulation, Monte Carlo simulation, stochastic modeling and decision analysis under uncertainty.

• Experience building optimization or planning models that real operations ran on, beyond academic work.

• Strong formulation skills in mixed-integer and/or constraint programming.

• Experience with optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, etc.).

• Experience with simulation tools such as AnyLogic, Simio, Arena or similar.

• Working knowledge of production planning: master scheduling, MRP, capacity planning, lot sizing and sequencing.

• Solid probability and statistics, including demand uncertainty and safety stock math.

• Production-quality Python and comfortable SQL.

• Advanced degree (MS or PhD preferred) in operations research, industrial engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, data science or a related quantitative field.

**Preferred**

• Experience at a supply chain planning software company (such as o9 Solutions, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis, SAP IBP or Coupa), or on an in-house planning or OR team at a manufacturer, retailer or 3PL.

• Rolling-horizon planning and schedule-stability methods used in production systems.

• Inventory optimization: service-level targets, (s, S) and (R, S) policies, multi-echelon networks.

• Forecasting for intermittent or lumpy demand (Croston, SBA, TSB) and probabilistic forecasts.

• Heuristics, metaheuristics or decomposition for large problem instances.

• Experience with simulation tools such as AnyLogic, Simio, Arena or similar.

• Process industries (chemicals, food, CPG): batches, shelf life, sequence-dependent cleaning.

• Experience with Indian mid-market manufacturers or their ERPs (Tally, SAP Business One).

• APICS CPIM or CSCP certification.

• Experience pairing optimization with LLM or agent systems.

• Familiarity with Silver, Pyke and Thomas, Inventory and Production Management in Supply Chains, the foundation of our engine.

**What We Offer**

• A founding-team role where you own the core IP the company is built on.

• Competitive salary plus meaningful ESOPs.

• Real customer data from day one, and a direct line to the founders.

• The chance to define how a new generation of supply chain software makes decisions.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
  
  
As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**About The Role.**
The Knowledge Engineering Lead is responsible for owning and evolving McCain’s Context Mesh, the proprietary knowledge layer that powers AI use cases across the enterprise. This role ensures that AI solutions are grounded in accurate, trusted, and business-validated knowledge across commercial, manufacturing, agriculture, supply chain, and corporate domains. Reporting to the VP, Artificial Intelligence, the position leads the organization’s knowledge engineering practice, manages domain-specific knowledge teams, and enables the successful integration of knowledge assets across the McCain AI stack, including Azure, Anthropic foundation models, Distyl technologies, Databricks, SAP, and Salesforce.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing.**

* Own and continuously evolve the McCain Context Mesh as the foundational knowledge layer supporting enterprise AI solutions.
* Define ontology architecture, taxonomy frameworks, metadata standards, and governance processes for McCain’s AI ecosystem.
* Lead and develop two domain sub-leads responsible for Commercial/Sales and Agriculture/Supply Chain ontologies.
* Establish and enforce knowledge engineering standards, methodologies, and quality controls across all domains.
* Coordinate cross-domain alignment and resolve ontology, taxonomy, and semantic modeling conflicts.
* Deploy and oversee Knowledge Engineers assigned to active AI use-case pods, ensuring consistent standards and practices while supporting project delivery.
* Partner with AI Platform & Engineering teams to integrate the Context Mesh into Distyl’s Distillery, Context Mesh, and Refinery capabilities.
* Ensure knowledge assets are grounded in Databricks data platforms and remain accessible, scalable, and reusable across AI applications.
* Collaborate with business leaders and subject matter experts to validate ontologies, capture emerging knowledge, and embed real-world workflows into AI solutions.
* Work closely with Forward Deployment Engineers, Use Case Governance & Operations, and the Architecture Review Board to ensure knowledge quality, source traceability, Responsible AI compliance, and architectural alignment.
* Drive the adoption of reusable knowledge patterns and semantic frameworks across the AI organization.
* Measure and improve the impact of knowledge engineering on AI solution accuracy, reliability, and business outcomes.

**What You’ll Need To Be Successful.**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Science, Linguistics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
* 18+ years of experience in knowledge engineering, ontology design, taxonomy management, semantic modeling, master data management, or a related discipline.
* 5+ years of people leadership experience managing specialized technical teams.

description:
We are looking for an experienced Folk with strong Commercial and Small Business Credit Risk expertise to lead client engagements across credit strategy, underwriting, portfolio management and risk analytics. This is a hands-on leadership role. Commercial & Small Business Credit Risk Engagement

* Strong understanding of commercial/SMB underwriting and portfolio management.

title: Lead AI Research Scientist (Robotics)
description:
**About Asiacruit**
At Asiacruit, we connect top talent with forward-thinking organizations across industries. Our mission is to help businesses grow through smart, strategic, and people-focused solutions. We support companies by providing high-quality talent for local and global markets.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a
**Lead Physical AI / Vision-Language-Action (VLA) Research Scientist**
to lead the development and adaptation of foundation models that connect visual perception, language understanding, and robotic actions.
  
  
You will guide research and implementation efforts to help robots interpret visual information, understand natural-language instructions, and generate meaningful actions for navigation and manipulation. The role combines multimodal AI, foundation model adaptation, robotic learning, and applied computer vision.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the adaptation and development of Vision-Language-Action models for robotic applications.
* Fine-tune open-weight VLA models such as OpenVLA, Octo, and π0 for navigation and manipulation tasks.
* Develop multimodal representations that connect camera observations, natural-language instructions, spatial reasoning, and robot actions.
* Design action-tokenization and spatial waypoint generation approaches for robotic behavior.
* Develop parameter-efficient fine-tuning pipelines using techniques such as LoRA and other PEFT methods.
* Work with vision-language models, Vision Transformers (ViT), and large multimodal models.
* Integrate visual perception and AI capabilities into robotic decision-making systems.
* Explore cross-embodiment learning and datasets such as Open X-Embodiment to improve model generalization across robotic platforms.
* Collaborate with robotics controls and embedded systems teams to translate model outputs into executable robot behaviors.
* Lead research planning, technical evaluations, experiments, and model performance improvements.
* Guide researchers and engineers in model adaptation, training, evaluation, and deployment.

**Qualifications**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* At least 4 years of relevant experience in multimodal AI, foundation models, vision-language models, imitation learning, or robotic learning.
* Strong experience developing, training, or fine-tuning large multimodal models, Vision Transformers, or related deep learning architectures.
* Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch or JAX.
* Hands-on experience with vision-language models or Vision-Language-Action (VLA) architectures.
* Familiarity with open-weight VLA models such as OpenVLA, Octo, or π0.
* Experience with Hugging Face tools and model training or fine-tuning workflows.
* Practical knowledge of parameter-efficient fine-tuning techniques, including LoRA or related methods.
* Understanding of multimodal representation learning, visual perception, and language-conditioned action generation.
* Familiarity with robotic imitation learning, policy learning, or reinforcement learning.
* Understanding of cross-embodiment robotic learning and datasets such as Open X-Embodiment is an advantage.
* Ability to lead technical research, evaluate experimental results, and translate research findings into practical AI capabilities.

**Why Join?**

* Lead the development of emerging Physical AI and VLA technologies.
* Work at the intersection of multimodal AI, foundation models, and robotics.
* Explore new approaches to language-conditioned robotic navigation and manipulation.
* Collaborate with AI researchers and robotics engineers to translate research into real-world applications.
* Shape technical direction and research priorities for advanced AI systems.

**Work Location & Arrangement**
Remote through a US-based research team, or hybrid in New Delhi, India. Remote eligibility is subject to the employer's approved work locations.

**Principal Robotics Controls Engineer (Locomotion & MPC/RL)**

You will design and implement control algorithms that enable robots to navigate uneven terrain, transition between gaits, recover from external disturbances, and execute movements reliably. * Develop and validate gait transitions, obstacle negotiation, stair climbing, and recovery from external disturbances.
* Build simulation-based training and testing pipelines using NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim, or comparable robotics simulation environments.
* Develop Sim-to-Real workflows to transfer locomotion policies from simulation to physical robots.
* Integrate motion control systems with motor controllers and communication networks, including CAN-FD and EtherCAT.

* Strong understanding of robot kinematics, rigid-body dynamics, and multi-body systems.
* Hands-on experience developing locomotion or motion control algorithms for legged robots.
* Strong proficiency in modern C++ and C++20.
* Practical experience with Model Predictive Control (MPC), nonlinear optimization, and Quadratic Programming (QP).
* Experience with Whole-Body Control (WBC) or related model-based control approaches.
* Familiarity with robotics libraries and frameworks such as Pinocchio, Drake, or OCS2.
* Experience with reinforcement learning for robotics or locomotion policy development.
* Familiarity with NVIDIA Isaac Lab, Isaac Gym, RaiSim, or equivalent simulation platforms.
* Understanding of real-time control and PREEMPT\_RT Linux environments.
* Experience integrating control software with physical robot hardware and motor communication systems.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to lead complex robotics engineering projects.

**Why Join?**

* Lead the development of advanced robotic locomotion and control systems.
* Work on challenging problems involving dynamic balance, terrain traversal, and autonomous movement.
* Combine control theory, simulation, reinforcement learning, and physical robot testing.
* Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to move robotics research into practical applications.

title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer
description:

We work at the frontier of applied speech and language AI, and our research directly shapes products used by enterprise customers every day.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal AI Research Engineer to set the technical direction for our most ambitious AI initiatives. You will lead research on large language models, speech understanding, and retrieval systems—then translate that research into production capabilities at scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for someone who thrives at the intersection of cutting-edge research and real-world deployment, and who can raise the technical bar across the entire AI organization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Define and drive the research roadmap for core AI capabilities spanning LLMs, ASR/speech understanding, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic systems.
* Design, train, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art models, taking them from prototype to robust, production-grade systems.

* Partner closely with product, platform, and ML engineering teams to ship research into customer-facing features.
* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, set technical standards, and act as a force multiplier across the AI org.

**What You'll Bring**

* Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent research experience; typically 7+ years applying ML/AI in production settings.
* Deep expertise in modern deep learning, with strong command of LLMs, transformers, and at least one of speech/ASR, NLP, information retrieval, or multimodal modeling.
* A track record of taking research from idea to deployed, scaled product—not just publications, but shipped impact.
* Expert-level proficiency in Python and a major deep learning framework (PyTorch preferred), with strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Hands-on experience training and serving large models, including distributed training, optimization, and efficient inference.
* Demonstrated technical leadership: setting direction, mentoring engineers, and influencing across teams.
* Clear communicator able to convey complex technical ideas to both research and product audiences.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in conversational AI, contact center, or speech analytics domains.
* Publications at top-tier venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ACL, EMNLP, Interspeech) or significant open-source contributions.
* Experience with agentic frameworks, tool use, and orchestration of LLM-based systems.
* Familiarity with model safety, alignment, and responsible AI evaluation.

**Why Level AI**

* Work on AI problems that ship to real enterprise customers at scale, with measurable impact.
* Join a small, high-caliber team where your technical decisions shape the product and the org.
* Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and comprehensive benefits.
* A culture that values research depth and pragmatic, production-focused execution in equal measure.

*Level AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

title: Research Scientist
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We're building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We're looking for an
**Research Scientist**
to push the boundaries of what AI systems can actually do.
  
  
Not someone who simply integrates existing models or builds another wrapper around an LLM. We're looking for someone who can identify why today's AI systems fail, develop new methods to overcome those limitations, and turn research breakthroughs into real-world capabilities.
  
  
You'll work on some of the hardest problems in applied AI: building autonomous agents that can plan, reason, execute complex tasks and recover from failures; improving model intelligence through reinforcement learning and post-training; and developing systems that can make reliable decisions in unpredictable environments.
  
  
We're looking for someone who doesn't just ask how to use the best available model, but how to make AI fundamentally better at solving problems it struggles with today.
  
  
**The Job**

* Push the boundaries of agentic AI. Research and develop new approaches that enable AI agents to independently plan, reason, use tools, execute complex tasks, adapt to unfamiliar environments and recover from failures.
* Advance reinforcement learning and model training. Experiment with RL, fine-tuning, post-training techniques and model architectures to improve reasoning, decision-making and autonomous behaviour beyond what existing models can achieve.
* Develop new methods for reasoning and multimodal intelligence. Investigate why models struggle with complex, multi-step problems and unstructured inputs, and design new algorithms and techniques to improve their capabilities.
* Design rigorous experiments and AI evaluations. Build benchmarks, evaluation frameworks and experimental methodologies to measure model intelligence, reliability, generalisation and failure modes. Use findings to drive meaningful improvements.
* Take original research from first principles to production. Identify unsolved problems, formulate hypotheses, build and test new approaches, and collaborate with Research Engineers to translate breakthroughs into scalable AI systems with measurable real-world impact.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have a PhD in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience conducting original AI research.
* Have a strong track record of original research, demonstrated through publications at venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL or EMNLP, impactful open-source contributions, or meaningful advances in production AI systems.
* Have deep expertise in one or more areas such as agentic AI, reinforcement learning, LLM reasoning, post-training, multimodal learning, model architectures or AI evaluations.
* Are highly proficient in Python and PyTorch, with hands-on experience designing experiments, training and fine-tuning models, building evaluation frameworks and independently implementing research ideas.
* Are intellectually curious, comfortable challenging existing approaches and excited by unsolved problems. You combine scientific rigour with strong engineering instincts and care about taking original research from experimentation to real-world impact.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning & development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
  
  
*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

title: Head of Quantitative Research & Algorithmic Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**

Univest is seeking a
**Head of Quantitative Research & Algorithmic Engineering**
to architect, build, and scale our next-generation automated trading and wealth management infrastructure. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end lifecycle of systematic strategies in Indian derivatives (NSE Equities, Index & Stock Options/Futures)—from mathematical model design and backtesting to building low-latency, production-grade Python/C++ execution engines and broker API integrations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategy Research & Quantitative Modeling:**

* Design, validate, and deploy high-alpha systematic strategies (options arbitrage, dynamic delta-hedging, mean-reversion, trend-following, and statistical arbitrage) for Indian F&O markets.
* Model volatility surfaces, Option Greeks, order-book dynamics, and market microstructure to build robust edge cases.
* Conduct rigorous backtesting, walk-forward validation, and stress-testing (Probability of Backtest Overfitting, Monte Carlo simulations) to eliminate curve-fitting.

**Algorithmic Execution & Infrastructure Engineering:**

* Architect and program scalable, cloud-native server-side execution systems in
  **Python and C++**
  interfacing with broker APIs, OMS/EMS, and FIX protocols.
* Optimize execution algorithms to minimize market impact, slippage, and latencies across multi-broker retail setups.
* Build automated pre-trade and post-trade risk management engines handling real-time position limits, dynamic margin utilization, and drawdown controls.

**Leadership & Scale:**

* Own the strategy deployment roadmap across retail and high-net-worth portfolio tiers.
* Oversee data pipelines (tick-level/L2/L3 order book data), infrastructure, and strategy monitoring systems.

**Requirements**

* **Quantitative Depth:**
  Proven mastery of option pricing models (Black-Scholes, IV surfaces), stochastic calculus, statistical arbitrage, and risk metrics (VaR, Sharpe/Sortino, max drawdown controls).
* **Hands-on Production Code:**
  100% mandatory expertise in Python and/or modern C++ (C++17/20) for building backend trading engines, data pipelines, and API integrations.
* **Indian Derivatives Experience:**
  Deep, hands-on experience trading or engineering strategies specifically for NSE Index & Stock Options / Futures (Nifty, BankNifty, Stock Derivatives).
* Execution & Microstructure: Practical experience with broker APIs, OMS/EMS architectures, FIX protocol, or low-latency execution routing.

You will operate at both strategic and hands-on levels-designing long-term architectural blueprints while actively shaping core systems in their earliest stages. This role is not about maintaining existing systems. It is about laying the foundations for a platform that will define the next decade of the company’s growth.

title: Director - T&O Data Engineering
description:

As a member of the Data Office organization, you will partner closely with product managers, data stewards, platform engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and senior business stakeholders to deliver enterprise data capabilities that enable analytics, reporting, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and digital products. The team is at the forefront of shaping BlackRock's next generation data ecosystem and driving data as a strategic asset across the firm.
  
  
**Your role and impact**
As a Director, Data Engineering, you will provide technical leadership for enterprise-scale data platforms architect who wants to do more than produce designs or provide technical advice, and drive the delivery of high-impact data solutions that support critical business and investment outcomes. You will define architectural direction for complex engineering initiatives, establish best practices across teams, serve as a trusted partner to stakeholders across technology and the business, and measurable improvements in reliability, scalability, performance, and developer productivity.
  
  
This role offers the opportunity to shape long-term data strategy, mentor engineering talent, and accelerate the firm's adoption of modern data and AI-enabled capabilities
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**
In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and combine the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies with the rigor to challenge the results. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Define and evolve the target-state architecture for enterprise-scale data platforms, shared services, application programming interfaces (APIs), software development kits (SDKs), metadata, configuration, and data models, while guiding investments and technology adoption that improve scalability, reliability, performance, security, interoperability, and developer experience.
* Partner with engineering, product, and operations teams from technical discovery and prototyping through implementation, rollout, and adoption, validating architectural decisions against production outcomes and adjusting designs as needed.
* Define and drive technology strategy, target-state architecture, and engineering direction across application and data platforms while ensuring alignment with broader BlackRock Data Office strategy.
* Provide technical leadership for distributed application, integration, and data platforms, guiding critical design and architecture decisions across enterprise data technologies.
* Translate business priorities into executable technology roadmaps with planned delivery objectives.
* Establish engineering standards and ensure solutions are designed for quality, resilience, security, operational excellence, and governance.
* Partner with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate strategic trade-offs, manage dependencies, and maximize business outcomes.
* Develop senior engineering talent and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Drive adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities and intelligent automation opportunities while maintaining appropriate risk and control standards.

**Your Experience**

* Extensive experience in data platform architecture, data engineering, distributed systems, or related disciplines, including designing scalable, reliable, high-performance, and cost-effective enterprise data platforms across complex, multi-team environments.
* Experience designing governed data platforms for AI and structure, semi-structure and unstructured-data workloads, including object storage, document management, metadata, retrieval, vector or graph technologies, security, and operational reliability.
* Deep expertise in Python, Java, Scala, SQL, Snowflake, DBT, cloud-based data platforms, and large-scale distributed data analytics environments, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade solutions.
* Strong experience designing and operating high-volume batch and real-time data pipelines, workflow orchestration solutions, data-transformation frameworks, and distributed event streaming architectures.
* Expertise in cloud and hybrid technology environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, containerized platforms, infrastructure automation, data governance, metadata management, lineage, and enterprise security controls.
* Strong understanding of application programming interfaces, data modeling, data-quality frameworks, observability, performance optimization, and modern software-engineering practices supporting scalable platforms.
* Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, driving architectural decisions, and influencing organizational standards in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
* Exposure to machine learning, artificial intelligence, generative AI, and enterprise data patterns that enable AI-ready products and platforms.
* Proven architecture leadership and technical judgment across workflow orchestration, Data Operations, release management, observability, cloud infrastructure, and source-control and delivery platforms, with the ability to simplify systems and make pragmatic trade-offs.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
  
  
BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Supply Chain Solutions Manager
description:
**About Praxas AI**

Every company runs on an ERP. Very few get good decisions out of it. That's where Praxas comes in.

Praxas AI is an AI-native supply chain platform that works as a decision layer on top of the systems a company already has. We pull in scattered data from ERPs, spreadsheets and email, turn it into a single, trusted picture, and use optimization models and AI agents to recommend what to produce, stock, buy and ship. Plans keep re-optimizing as orders, capacity and supply change, and planners stay in control by approving every action.

What we stand for is simple: no rip-and-replace, no multi-year implementations, and no multi-million-dollar planning suites. We're building planning software that's fast to deploy, easy to use and priced for mid-sized companies.

We're starting with production planning for manufacturers, because that's where our first clients feel the most pain. Inventory, sourcing and shipping come next, followed by industries such as CPG, retail, chemicals and logistics. Our first manufacturing partners are already sharing their data and building the product with us. Built in India, for the world.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to embed with our clients and turn their messiest supply chain problems into optimized plans running in production.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a traditional consulting, project management or customer success position. You'll sit with planners and plant heads to understand how the business really runs, formulate the right mathematical model, write production-quality code, connect our platform to their ERP, and stay until the plan is trusted and used every day. You'll move between a factory floor, a solver, an ERP database and a conversation with the owner without losing the thread.

Our clients' data lives in SAP, Tally, custom ERPs, spreadsheets and inboxes, and it's rarely clean. The work is never turnkey. You'll own hard implementation problems through to resolution, and turn what you learn in the field into reusable connectors, models and playbooks that make the next deployment faster.

You'll work directly with the founders and our engineering team. As one of our first hires, you'll help define how Praxas is built, deployed and sold.

**What You Will Do**

Deliver supply chain solutions

• Embed with clients from discovery through go-live, stabilization and handover

• Map each client's production, inventory, sourcing and logistics processes, and the data behind them

• Translate business goals and ambiguous requirements into clear models, milestones and working software

• Own the outcomes clients care about: fewer lost sales, better on-time-in-full delivery, higher inventory turns and working capital released

Model and optimize

• Formulate and solve production planning and scheduling, inventory and safety stock, demand forecasting and supply planning problems

• Use linear and mixed-integer programming, constraint programming and heuristics, with solvers such as Gurobi, CPLEX or OR-Tools

• Build models that re-optimize continuously as orders, capacity and supply change

• Validate models against real client data, test them on past periods, and explain trade-offs clearly to planners

Engineer in the client environment

• Write production-quality code in Python and SQL

• Build and maintain ERP connectors for SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics and custom databases, using APIs, OData and direct SQL

• Build data pipelines and data-quality checks, and reconcile Praxas numbers with the client's own reports

• Deploy and troubleshoot client environments on AWS, working within each client's IT and security controls

• Integrate AI agents into planning workflows, with human approval at every step

Build client capability

• Run workshops, design reviews and hands-on training for planners, purchase teams and plant heads

• Build trust in the system's recommendations so clients act on them every day

• Communicate trade-offs and risks clearly to planners, managers and owners

• Keep scope disciplined and make realistic technical commitments

Make the product better

• Turn recurring client needs into product features, reusable connectors and deployment templates

• Cut implementation time with every deployment

• Write clear documentation: data maps, model specs, runbooks and decision logs

**What Success Looks Like

In the first 90 days**

• Build a working knowledge of the Praxas data model, planning engine and deployment setup

• Take one client from data access to a production plan running on their live data, with numbers that match their own reports

• Build or strengthen at least one reusable ERP connector

• Write documentation that makes the next client onboarding faster

**Within 6–12 months**

• Lead several client deployments end to end, from discovery to daily use

• Cut onboarding time from weeks to days

• Show measurable impact at your clients, such as fewer lost sales, lower inventory and better on-time delivery

• Turn field lessons into product features, connectors and playbooks the whole team uses

Who You Are

Required

• 3–8 years building or implementing supply chain planning solutions, at a platform such as o9, Blue Yonder, Kinaxis or SAP IBP, at an implementation partner, or in a similar role

• Exceptional coding ability: you write production-quality Python and SQL, and you're comfortable with APIs, data pipelines and cloud deployment

• Strong operations research and mathematical modelling: linear and mixed-integer programming, scheduling, heuristics, forecasting and inventory theory

• Hands-on experience with AI and machine learning, including building with large language models and AI agents and applying them to planning problems

• Hands-on experience integrating with ERPs such as SAP, Tally, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or custom systems

• Deep understanding of at least two of production planning and scheduling, demand planning, inventory planning, S&OP, procurement and logistics

• Proven client-facing skills: you can run a workshop, gather requirements and explain a model to someone who isn't technical

• Comfortable working on factory floors and travelling to client sites

Nice to have

• Experience in manufacturing, which is extremely beneficial

• A degree in operations research, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics

• Time at a startup or on an early product team

Compensation and Equity

• Competitive salary, with raises tied to company milestones

• Meaningful equity through ESOPs, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, so you own part of what you help build

• Early-team ownership: a real say in the product, the way we deploy it and the culture we build

**How to Apply**

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile to admin@praxas.ai with the subject line "Forward Deployed Engineer – Supply Chain". Include a short note on a model or integration you built, and what changed for the client because of it.

title: Senior AI Evaluation Engineer
description:
Engineering Expert
  
  
Role Overview
  
We are seeking experienced AI Evaluation Engineers specializing in engineering simulation and design to author and validate complex, simulation-based engineering problems for training and evaluating state-of-the-art AI agents. The role spans electrical, mechanical, control systems, aerospace, systems, and robotics engineering. You will create challenging, multi-constraint tasks that require agents to interpret requirements, navigate trade-offs, configure open-source simulation tools, diagnose failures, and iterate toward valid solutions. You will analyze agent execution logs, identify reasoning and tool-use gaps, and build objective automated graders.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
Author self-contained engineering design tasks with competing constraints, explicit optimization targets, validated reference solutions, and objective autograders.
  
Build, run, and validate problem environments using open-source simulation tools and custom Python test benches.
  
Analyze agent outputs and execution logs across repeated trials to identify systemic failure modes, such as misinterpreting simulator feedback, premature convergence, or physically impossible geometries.
  
Refine benchmark difficulty based on model performance data while avoiding ambiguity or missing information.
  
Collaborate with AI researchers, pod leads, and domain experts to integrate rigorous benchmarks into model-evaluation pipelines.
  
Requirements
  
A master's degree or PhD in electrical, mechanical, or aerospace engineering, and 10+ years of hands-on engineering design experience. The description also lists a bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in any field as an education pathway.
  
Proficiency in at least one relevant open-source simulation package, such as ngspice, PySpice, OpenFOAM, FEniCSx, CalculiX, python-control, CadQuery, build123d, OpenModelica, Cantera, or Gmsh, along with strong Python scripting skills.
  
Hands-on experience with modern LLMs or coding agents and evaluation concepts such as pass@k, failure-mode analysis, and nondeterministic behavior; ability to audit trajectory logs and isolate reasoning or tool-use failures.
  
Strong attention to physical plausibility, unit consistency, boundary conditions, convergence criteria, and technical documentation.
  
A stable, high-speed internet connection and a personal computer suitable for remote work.
  
Availability for 40 hours per week, four hours of overlap with PST, and weekend on-call availability. Part-time engagement is also noted as acceptable.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
  
  
With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.
  
  
Link to our fundraising announcement
  
  
**Key Offerings Of Hunch**

* One Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.

**About The Role**
We're on the lookout for a SDE-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We’re looking for immediate joiners. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own backend features end-to-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async & event-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.

**What You'll Bring**

* 5+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node + Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice-to-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design & delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End-to-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.

**Preferred Experience**

* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).

**Life at Hunch**
Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.
  
  
**What We Hire For - The ABCs**
Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
  
  

* Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.

**How We Work**

* Ownership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.

**Backed by Global Investors**
Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
  
  
**Experienced Leadership**
Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - India
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. title: AI Advisory and Governance Lead
description:
**About IDinsight**
*We're a global data and evidence advisory, working with governments, philanthropies, and non-profits to improve lives at scale, using technology and AI where they can deliver the most impact.*
IDinsight Is a Global Nonprofit That Equips Leaders With The Data, Evidence, And Technology To Improve Lives At Scale. We Partner With Governments, NGOs, Multilaterals, And Funders To Support Decisions At Every Stage Of Their Impact Journey – From Bold Pilots To Nationwide Scale-ups. Our Teams Bring Rigorous Evidence And Practical Insights So Leaders Can Make Informed Decisions That Truly Change Lives. With Our Partners, We Are Pioneering The Next Frontier Of Social Impact, Where Data And Technology Accelerate Progress For Millions. We Help Leaders Overcome The Three Main Barriers To Impact
  
  

* Figuring out what works
* Learning and improving
* Reaching and operating at scale

We work in multiple countries across Asia and Africa. Our work spans a wide range of sectors, including agriculture, education, health, governance, sanitation, financial inclusion, and other areas.
  
  
We Have Expertise In a Variety Of Rigorous Approaches And Methodologies, Which We Tailor To Each Client Depending On Their Needs And Constraints. To Achieve a Positive Social Impact, We
  
  

* Support our partners with the full ‘data and evidence’ value chain – from primary data collection to data systems, monitoring, evaluation, and learning tools, and data science
* Inform funding decisions – toward high-impact initiatives and away from less effective programs or approaches
* Create cutting-edge AI-for-good products that make the delivery of social interventions and learning tools more cost-effective and scalable

Our diverse, growing team of roughly 250 outstanding colleagues operates in nearly two dozen countries around the world. Learn more about our mission and values at
**www.IDinsight.org**
.
  
  
**Joining IDinsight at this moment**
IDinsight is entering an exciting new phase of growth. As demand for rigorous evidence and AI-enabled solutions accelerates across the sectors and geographies we work in, we are actively investing in our teams, deepening our regional footprint, and expanding the frontier of what data and technology can do for social impact. This is a moment of real momentum for IDinsight. We're looking for people who want to use data and evidence to improve lives at scale; who are energized by taking on problems without a playbook; and who want a hand in shaping what IDinsight becomes as we grow.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are hiring an entrepreneurial senior leader to strengthen and develop our AI Advisory practice for government and social sector clients in India. You will collaborate with IDinsight’s Senior Leadership, Executive, and Data Science teams to develop AI and technology aspects of current engagements, develop new engagements primarily with government partners, and support delivery of projects. Read more about our AI strategy.
  
  
The role is particularly suited to someone who understands technology transformation and policymaking in Indian government institutions. It combines client-facing advisory work with business development, and sits at the intersection of AI, governance, and public sector consulting. The role will ideally be based in Delhi, or require substantial time spent in Delhi.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Lead policy advisory and AI support for governments**
Support IDinsight's current government partners navigate the intersection of technology, AI, and policy, and grow our portfolio by engaging new government departments/agencies in AI and policy advisory.
  
  

* Policy advisory on AI: Support current and new government partners in:

+ Design and deployment of tech-enabled systems, including AI-native tools, data systems, and digital platforms — with a grounded understanding of requirements and constraints in Indian government settings, including data governance, procurement constraints, interoperability, and the political economy of adoption.
+ Developing policies, regulations, governance and capacity building frameworks shaping AI use in India.
+ Translating broad questions around into concrete, impactful opportunities and recommendations

* Client engagement: Participate in high-level meetings, workshops, and consortium discussions with government officials, funders, and partner organisations as a credible voice on technology, AI, and AI policy in governance contexts.
* Government client development: Identify and develop new opportunities to support governments on AI and technology, through active origination of new AI advisory engagements, conversion of leads, and drafting and reviewing proposals, growing the practice's pipeline and revenue especially with government organisations
* Represent IDinsight externally through thought leadership and public communications (blog posts, conference presentations, sector convenings, and written outputs) that advance IDinsight's profile and influence on AI transformation.

**Develop new AI advisory and evaluation engagements**
Grow IDinsight's AI advisory and evaluation practice with NGOs, social enterprises, and foundations.
  
  

* Client development: Identify, scope, and structure new engagements. Build relationships with prospective partners and develop proposals that match IDinsight's capabilities to client needs.
* AI Transformation Advisory: Serve as the senior lead on advisory and evaluation engagements - identifying the right use-cases; building, testing and evaluating AI-based products; and integrating AI products responsibly into client systems and workflows.
* Thought leadership: Represent IDinsight in sector conversations on AI in the social sector through writing and external engagement.
* Training and workshops: Design and deliver executive workshops, workflow redesign sessions, and training programs that build lasting client capability.

**Financial management**

* Demonstrate a strong understanding of IDinsight's business model and contribute to a financially sustainable practice through sound strategic decision-making and resource stewardship.
* Review budget design and resource allocation, ensuring financial planning supports quality delivery, funder expectations, and growth of the practice.
* Build trust with clients and funders through timely, accurate, and strategic financial reporting.

**Qualifications**
**Who we are looking for**

* Commitment to IDinsight's values and mission
* 6-10 years of professional experience, with significant time in consulting, digital transformation, product management, or technology implementation, ideally serving governments, foundations, or social sector organizations.
* Technical fluency: Strong understanding of LLM capabilities and limitations, AI agent architectures, and the practical realities of deploying AI in organizations. Ability to credibly direct a technical team. The role does not require production coding skills.
* Direct experience working with Indian government: Ideally ministries, national commissions, or large national programmes, with a strong understanding of how decisions get made and how change actually happens in these institutions, and the requirements that technology and AI systems must meet in government settings
* Client-facing consulting: Experience leading complex advisory engagements, managing senior client relationships, and delivering results against defined success metrics.
* People management: Track record of building, managing, and developing high-performing teams that include both technical and non-technical roles.
* Demonstrated experience in client development: identifying opportunities, scoping engagements, developing proposals, and building relationships with senior stakeholders.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with limited structure
* Entrepreneurial- can identify an opportunity and build from it without waiting for a fully defined brief.
* Strong communicator who can adapt between technical, bureaucratic, and donor audiences.

**Professional development**
Skill and career development are core to IDinsight's values and long-term impact strategy, and have been noted highlights of teammates’ experiences. IDinsighters receive significant mentorship from IDinsight leadership, support from talented peers, and are given considerable autonomy when ready. They maintain professional development plans and are given "stretch" opportunities designed to strengthen a variety of skills. Real-time feedback is embedded in our culture and formal structure enables maximum professional growth. Additionally, teammates have access to an annual professional development stipend that they are encouraged to utilize to explore their career interests and develop their skills.
  
  
**Nuts & bolts**
**Location**
This position is based in IDinsight’s Delhi office. Candidates should be willing to relocate to Delhi or travel substantially, often on short notice.
  
  
Start dates
  
  
We would prefer for the candidate to start immediately and in light of the urgency would be evaluating applications on a rolling basis.
  
  
**References**
Applications should include three references, including email, phone, and title. Briefly state in what capacity you worked with each reference.
  
  
**Work authorization**
**If you’re not willing to sponsor work authorization:**
IDinsight is not able to sponsor work authorization for this role. Successful candidates will not require IDinsight to sponsor their work authorization in the office in which they'll be based.
  
  
**If you’re willing to sponsor work authorization:**
IDinsight is able to sponsor employment visas for all nationalities in these locations; however, we will prioritize candidates who do not require IDinsight to sponsor work authorization in the aforementioned countries. All candidates who are not currently located in our country offices listed above will be expected to relocate to their office locations at the onset of their employment.
  
  
**Compensation & Benefits**
Compensation and benefits are commensurate with the qualifications and experiences IDinsight is hiring for, and competitive within the global development sector. We are especially proud of the people-focused benefits we offer including comprehensive international health insurance, including mental health coverage; paid vacation, sick, and parental leave; relocation benefits; a travel stipend; technology and work from home stipends; a professional development budget; and more.
  
  
Please note, as a non-profit, we are unable to provide compensation similar to leading private sector organizations.
  
  
**How To Apply**
This application includes several questions and requires a CV (one to two pages) covering your professional and personal experience as well as academic qualifications. Please omit headshots, parental details, birth dates, marital status, and similar personal information — these aren't relevant to our review.
  
  
More information, including details on I
**Dinsight’s hiring process**
and
**frequently asked questions**
, can be found online at IDinsight Careers. Any questions should be directed to india.careers@IDinsight.org.

IDinsight is committed to
**reducing power asymmetries in the social sector**
. Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion reflects our understanding of the need for the sector to abandon unhealthy practices of the past. We wish to be part of a new generation of international NGOs who are honest about this history and transparent about our role in the present. Our commitment is also aligned with the impact of our work.

This Also Helps Us Refine And Improve Our Methods And Relationships And Strengthen The Services We Provide Our Clients And Their Communities Or Constituencies. * IDinsight will have greater representation from the countries in which we work.
* Across all countries in which we recruit, we will seek greater representation from historically excluded communities.
* IDinsight will foster an inclusive work culture that empowers a diverse team to do their best work.

title: Quantitative Researcher - Experienced Hires (India)
description:
Trexquant is a systematic hedge fund where we use thousands of statistical algorithms to trade equity, futures and other markets globally. Starting with many data sets, we develop large sets of features and use various machine learning methods to discover trading signals and effectively combine them into market-neutral portfolios. We are looking for data scientists, physicists, engineers, economists and programmers to develop the next generation of machine learning strategies that can accurately predict the future movements of liquid financial assets. 

As a Quantitative Researcher you will be involved in developing market-neutral signals, parsing and analyzing large data sets and collaborating with the Data and Strategy Research team to build a diverse set of predictive models. While we are open to researchers in any asset class we are currently focusing on roles in equities, futures, commodities, and event driven research. 

****Responsibilities****

* Design, implement, and optimize various machine learning models aimed at predicting liquid assets using a wide set of financial data and a vast library of trading signals
* Parse and analyze large datasets to identify actionable alpha signals and develop strategies for systematic trading
* Investigate and implement state-of-the-art academic research in the field of quantitative finance
* Continuously innovate and improve existing models by integrating new data sources and advanced techniques to boost performance and scalability
* Collaborate closely with a team of experienced quantitative researchers to conduct experiments, backtest hypotheses, and refine strategies through rigorous simulations and data analysis

**Requirements**

* BS/MS/PhD degree in any stem field
* 2+ years in a systematic trading environment
* Passion for machine learning
* Fluent with programming languages like Python
* Strong problem-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively both as an individual and a team player

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary plus bonus based on individual and company performance
* Collaborative, Casual, and friendly work environment
* Health insurance premiums fully covered for you and your dependents
* Pre-tax commuter benefits
* Weekly company meals

Trexquant is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Manager, CRM Optimization & Innovation
description:

Bain & Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.

Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

  

**Position Summary**

The position is in the CRM Team based at Bain’s GBS office in Gurgaon, New Delhi, and is an integral part of the Global Commercial Operations department. It requires effective collaboration with team members, internal departments, and product or process owners around the globe. With a focus on driving business outcomes, the Manager advises internal stakeholders on leveraging CRM capabilities and insights to support informed decision-making. Your role will also involve leading a team of data analysts and ensuring team members are equipped with the tools and skills they need to fulfill their core responsibilities within the team. You will work continuously with senior leadership to manage team capacity and project work, to deliver in a timely fashion. Attention to detail and analytical skills will be critical to success in this role.  In addition to partnering with and learning from the key leaders in our business you will have access to the unrivalled support and professional development we offer to all members of the Bain team.

  

**Essential Functions:**

**Own projects and initiatives related to advanced analytics**

* Leads a team of data analysts, who are utilizing their advanced technical skills to support complex end user requests that require data to be visualized from multiple sources
* Work with fellow CRM team members to continuously review, optimize and automate current data integrity and enrichment processes using technical tools such as Python, Tableau, Alteryx, SQL, and AI solutions.
* Evaluate best in market tools and provide solutions which will lead to efficiencies (time savings) as well as automation (advancement) on team’s processes.
* Leads projects and initiatives requests relating to data quality often require quick turnaround time. Collaborate closely with the wider Global CRM team and communicate with the senior stakeholders during various phases of these projects or requests including cross-functional collaboration.

  

**Invests comprehensively in continuous development of programs**

* Evaluates current CRM design and propose functional improvements in the system to enhance overall user experience. Articulates clear recommendations on how to improve the interface/processes and thus quality of CRM output.
* Utilizes exceptional communication skills to develop programming and deliver insights. Drives necessary process changes and facilitates brainstorming with impacted stakeholders to get to resolve issues and build consensus. Use PowerPoint slides and other technical tools to deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership globally.
* Regularly analyzes processes for improvements and optimization. Identify opportunities for saving overall time and effort used in the process. Innovation & Continuous Learning: Use newer technology and insights from regular data monitoring to identify and resolve problems.

  

**People Management**

* Oversee day-to-day CRM analytics projects. Collaborates with other senior leaders within the New Delhi GBS office to manage oversight of the entire team.
* Works with senior leadership to ensure regular processes and project work do not exceed team capacity

title: Platform Engineer — Healthcare AI Platform USA
description:
**Company:**
Cosentus

**Experience:**
3–5 Years
