* Notus modernization / recoding / migration activities (e.g., the confirmed move from Azure Batch to Databricks in GDP; PoC/benchmark contributions; industrialization work).
* Contributions to GDP-connected initiatives under the GRM governance streams (Natural Event Platform, Solvency 2 Internal Model and related technical excellence tracks).
* Participate in design reviews to ensure “build-to-run” quality: operability, monitoring, cost guardrails, and documentation before production release.
* Stakeholder management & governance rhythm
* Act as the operational focal point for GRM and platform stakeholders, participating in governance/rituals (initiative reviews, risk follow-ups) as required.
* Provide clear communication on incidents, risks, dependencies, and operational improvements.

**Specialist Skills & Experience (must-have)**
Databricks & Data Engineering
  
  

* good hands-on expertise with Databricks in production contexts (workflows/jobs scheduling, cluster policies, libraries, notebooks, troubleshooting).
* Advanced PySpark and SQL skills for investigation and remediation of data and pipeline issues.
* Experience with production support for data platforms/app ecosystems (L2/L3).

Run/Service Management
  
  

* Proven experience operating services under SLA/OLA constraints: incident/problem/change management, runbooks, operational reporting.

Cost / Performance / Reliability
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to manage compute cost, performance tuning, and reliability improvements—particularly relevant for scalable run workloads

**Desired Skills And Abilities**

* Experience in cloud data platforms and enterprise data governance constraints (access management, secure data handling).
* Familiarity with integration patterns (API management, managed file transfer approaches) in data exchange ecosystems.
* Exposure to risk modeling / catastrophe modeling application contexts (helpful but not required).

Key interfaces (who the role works with)
  
  

* GRM Tech & Product stakeholders (application owners, BAU owners, governance leads) across Natural Event Platform, STEC apps
* AXA GO, mainly GDP & CFGP teams (engineering) but as well transversal GO families such as security, access management, architecture supporting the platform releases and readiness.
* Project teams during transformations

Success measures (KPIs / outcomes)
  
  

* High service stability: reduced incident volume, improved MTTR, fewer recurring problems.
* Operational readiness: complete runbooks, monitoring coverage, predictable release transitions.
* Cost and performance control: measurable improvements in compute cost monitoring and optimization (especially on Notus run consumption).
* Stakeholder satisfaction (derived from the three criteria above): clear communication, reliable support, proactive risk management.

Working model (ESS – India)
  
  

* Coverage aligned to GRM needs.
* On call / extended support windows if required during major releases or critical incidents.

Who WE are
  
  
AXA XL, the P&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
  
  
How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.
  
  
With an innovative and flexible approach to risk solutions, we partner with those who move the world forward.
  
  
Learn more at axaxl.com
  
  
What we OFFER
  
  
Inclusion
  
  
AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic. At AXA XL, we know that an inclusive culture and enables business growth and is critical to our success. We’re committed to rewarding your contribution for the long term, so you can be your best self today and look forward to the future with confidence.
  
  
Sustainability
  
  
At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. We know that sustainability is at the root of a more resilient future. Our 2023-26 Sustainability strategy, called “Roots of resilience”, focuses on protecting natural ecosystems, addressing climate change, and embedding sustainable practices across our operations.

title: Snowflake+Databricks+AI - Associate 2
description:

As a Snowflake+Databricks+AI Associate, you will support data engineering work within our Data and Analytics Engineering practice, helping design and build data pipelines, data integration, and data transformation solutions that turn raw data into usable insights for clients. As an Associate you will learn from more experienced team members, contribute to client engagement tasks, adapt to changing project needs, and develop your technical skills while taking ownership of assigned work and delivering careful, consistent results. * Learning Agile delivery methods and team-based problem solving
* Adapting quickly in client-facing, fast-paced technology settings

title: Solution Engineering - Apps & AI
description:
**Overview**
Work with multinational enterprise customers to achieve their business goals using Azure as their platform of choice. Open doors, become a trusted technical adviser, uncover opportunities and turn their ambitions into practical solutions that deliver business value.
  
  
Combine an enterprise-architecture mindset and broad cloud understanding with strong, hands-on Apps and AI expertise. You do not need to be the deepest expert in every Azure service; know how a complete solution fits together and when to involve specialists and subject matter experts.
  
  
This role offers autonomy and influence across customer organisations. Own the technical direction of complex opportunities, align teams when priorities are unclear and take responsibility for achieving agreed technical outcomes. Work from executive conversations to practical demonstrations, challenging assumptions constructively and drawing on account teams, specialists and partners.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Technical Sales Leadership
  
  

* Proactively build customer access, discover unmet needs across Azure and create new technical opportunities that deliver business value.
* Independently lead complex engagements spanning multiple technologies, teams and customer locations. Align stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and drive technical decisions through discovery, workshops and demonstrations.

Application Modernization
  
  

* Help customers modernise applications using Azure and cloud-native approaches, balancing existing investments with future business needs.
* Guide modern software delivery and developer productivity, including GitHub and GitHub Copilot, to accelerate innovation.

AI & Intelligent Applications
  
  

* Shape intelligent applications and agent solutions using Microsoft Foundry, Copilot technologies and enterprise data, including Microsoft Fabric where relevant.
* Build focused prototypes and demonstrations to test customer ideas, show value and guide secure, responsible AI adoption.

Solution Design & Architecture
  
  

* Take an end-to-end view across Azure infrastructure, networking, identity, security, data, applications and AI, including hybrid environments.
* Adapt and extend architecture patterns for complex customer requirements. Make clear recommendations on trade-offs between business value, security, reliability and cost, and develop practical roadmaps rather than isolated product designs.
* Work with specialists, customer success and partners to help customers progress from architecture to adoption.

Customer & Market Engagement
  
  

* Build trusted relationships from developers and architects to Heads of Development and VPs; listen, challenge constructively and build consensus across technical and business stakeholders.
* Understand customer priorities, programmes and decision-makers, aligning technical engagement with their wider business and transformation strategy.

Sales & Business Impact
  
  

* Use business and commercial judgement to connect technical choices to customer outcomes and differentiated Microsoft value, building a clear case for investment.
* Qualify technical opportunities around clear customer needs and business value, and agree meaningful next steps.
* Shape the strategy for winning and growing opportunities with account teams, using customer and competitive insight to guide investment decisions and overcome technical barriers.

Team & Community Contribution
  
  

* Lead collaboration across teams and coach technical colleagues and account teams. Create reusable architectures and approaches from customer engagements, and help others apply them to improve outcomes beyond your own opportunities.
* Maintain hands-on learning, relevant skills and certifications, and demonstrate inclusion, integrity and customer focus.

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
  
**Meet One Of The Following Alternatives**

* Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience;
* OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 6+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience;
* OR 7+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience;
* OR equivalent experience.

Technical Experience
  
  

* Proven experience across technical selling and delivery, leading complex opportunities across multiple technologies and teams from discovery to practical validation. Evidence of sound architectural decisions when requirements are unclear and influence beyond your own work.
* Strong understanding of Azure, enterprise architecture and how infrastructure, security, data, applications and AI work together.
* Hands-on application development and AI capability, including building prototypes and explaining technical choices to customers.
* Experience with modern software delivery and developer productivity, using Microsoft technologies or comparable platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication and commercial judgement, with the ability to work independently from practitioner to executive level and navigate ambiguity across organisational boundaries.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 8+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.
* 6+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
* Experience with enterprise modernization, AI solutions or multinational customer engagements, including Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Microsoft Fabric or GitHub.
* Relevant cloud, AI, development, architecture or security certifications.

What Success Looks Like
  
  

* Customers seek your advice and involve you in their technical and business priorities.
* Strong relationships reveal new technical opportunities and support customer growth.
* Complex opportunities move forward because your architecture recommendations and technical proof help customers resolve trade-offs and make confident investment decisions.
* Customers experience a coordinated Microsoft team, and colleagues reuse your architectures and approaches to achieve stronger outcomes.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: GTM Engineer
description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
Payoneer is looking for a GTM Engineer to help drive our Outbound engine (Sales Development). This role directly impacts pipeline and revenue. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable working with AI coding, systems, tools, automations, and integrations. Equally important, this is not solely a technical role: we’re looking for a rare blend of a hands-on builder and a strategic, sales-oriented operator — someone with strong sales acumen who recognizes which levers move revenue and can drive them across teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Engineer the Outbound operations. Own the automations, integrations, and AI-driven workflows that power outbound sales ops. Use AI coding tools to ship working solutions fast and debug them as needed.
  
  

* Be the glue for global Outbound ops. Connect the teams that execute and support the SDR teams and Outbound Pods — collaborate with Sales leadership and multiple cross-functional teams to drive Outbound performance (SDRs, BDMs, RevOps, Analytics, Lead Research, and Marketing).
* Drive SDR & Outbound BDM performance. Orchestrate the full range of levers that drive SDR and Outbound BDM performance — targeting, lead routing, outreach, handoff, training, accreditation, etc.
* Event performance. Partner with regional Marketing teams, SDRs, and BDMs to run the operations that drive event performance — vetting events, lead generation before/during/after events, etc.
* Automations & workflows. Partner with the AI & RevOps teams to orchestrate AI-driven workflows and processes that reduce manual work and increase SDR & BDM throughput and performance.
* Operational excellence & KPIs. Identify what drives results, iterate quickly, and feed learnings back into targeting logic, outreach design, and sales operations.
* AI-SDR motion. Collaborate with the AI & RevOps teams to build the strategic AI-SDR motion.

**Requirements**
A rare blend of a hands-on technical builder and a strategic, sales-oriented operator.
  
  

* 5-7 years in B2B tech sales at a top tech company or high-growth startup, including 4+ years in RevOps / Sales Ops.
* Coding. Working knowledge of Python and JavaScript. You don’t need to be a full-blown SW engineer, but you can work with AI tools to produce code that runs and works, and debug it as needed.
* Hands-on experience with at least one AI coding tool (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor).
* Experience with APIs, scraping, webhooks, data feeds, and other elements of workflows & systems.
* Experience with Salesforce.

**Bonus**

* Experience in Outbound / Sales Development.
* Experience with Clay, Gong, Lemlist, Aircall.

**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About Chariot**

Chariot is a frontier AI research lab based in Delhi, building foundation models. We're one of the original four teams selected under the IndiaAI Mission to build models from India. We want our models to work as well in Indian languages as the best AI systems work in English.

**The Role**

You'll build and own products powered by Chariot's models, from understanding a user's problem and deciding what to build to shipping it, measuring how it performs, and improving it.

This is a hands-on engineering role across the frontend and backend. You'll work directly with users and researchers, make product and engineering decisions, and take responsibility for both the user experience and the systems behind it. Your ownership continues after launch: understanding whether people are getting value, finding where the product falls short, and deciding what to improve next.

What you'll work on

1. **Understand users and shape the product.**
   Work directly with users to understand their needs, identify problems worth solving, and decide what to build. Scope work into useful increments and make clear choices about what belongs in the first version and what can wait.
2. **Build and ship across the stack.**
   Turn ideas into working products, from interfaces and user flows to APIs and backend services. Own features through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
3. **Measure and improve.**
   Decide what success looks like and instrument products to understand how people use them. Use usage data, feedback, and failure patterns to improve the experience and guide what you build next.
4. **Own the systems behind your products.**
   Build and operate backend services that perform reliably under real load, including APIs, queues, storage, and integrations with model inference. Improve latency, throughput, reliability, and cost as usage grows.
5. **Connect product feedback to model quality.**
   Work with researchers to understand where models succeed or fail in real use. Build evaluation tools and automated checks that measure the quality of model-powered features, catch regressions, and help guide improvements.

What we look for

* **Strong product sense.**
  You can work through an ambiguous user problem, choose what matters, and explain why. You know how to scope a first version, decide what to measure, and use evidence to improve it.
* **Extensive experience building and operating backend systems at scale.**
  You've owned production services under real load, handled failures, and made informed tradeoffs around architecture, performance, reliability, and cost.
* **Full-stack engineering ability.**
  You're comfortable building usable interfaces and the services behind them, and carrying a feature through to production. You pay attention to the details that make a product clear and easy to use.
* **Strong software fundamentals, especially in Python.**
  You write maintainable code, understand distributed systems and data infrastructure, and can investigate problems across the stack.
* **Thoughtful use of AI tools.**
  AI tools are part of how you build. You know how to give them useful context, review their output, and verify correctness. You remain accountable for the code, architecture, and user experience you ship.
* **Ownership beyond launch.**
  You follow through on adoption, quality, and reliability. You're comfortable revisiting decisions and changing course when something isn't working.

Experience with model serving, GPU infrastructure, large-scale data pipelines, ML evaluation, speech systems, or multilingual products is a strong plus.

How to apply

Send us your resume, links to code or products you've built, and a short note on why this role interests you.

* Tell us about a product or feature you owned end to end: how you chose what to build, the scale and engineering challenges involved, and what you learned from users after launch.

title: Software Development Engineer 2
description:

NikahForever is India’s most trusted Muslim Matrimony platform, dedicated to making marriages simple and accessible. With

and over

You'll take unclear problems and turn them into reliable, production-grade systems. You won't get a detailed spec. You'll get a problem, context, and the freedom to decide how to solve it. You'll own the full lifecycle: understanding the problem, designing, building, shipping, monitoring and iterating.

We're AI-native. You'll use coding agents and agentic workflows daily to move faster, and you stay fully accountable for everything you ship.

We don't hire based on familiarity with a particular programming language, framework, or technology stack.
**We value strong fundamentals, problem-solving ability, learning speed, engineering judgment, and the ability to deliver working software.**

**What You'll Do**

* Own features and services end to end, from discovery and design through deployment and monitoring
* Work across backend, data, infrastructure, integrations and AI-powered workflows, depending on what the problem needs
* Make and defend architectural trade-offs (performance, cost, complexity, speed)
* Debug production failures, find root causes, and improve observability and resilience
* Build internal tools and automations that remove repetitive engineering work
* Prototype quickly, validate assumptions, and turn what works into production code
* Use AI agents, tool calling and MCP integrations to compress delivery cycles, and review their output critically
* Raise the bar on code quality and engineering practices through your own work and reviews

**Must have**

* 2-4 years building and running production software
* Strong fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, databases, OS/networking basics, concurrency, system design
* Experience across more than one domain, such as backend/APIs, data-heavy systems, queues and async processing, cloud and deployment, third-party integrations, or AI/LLM applications
* Comfort entering an unfamiliar codebase and learning a new language or tool when the problem demands it
* Hands-on use of AI coding tools, and the judgment to catch hallucinations and hidden failure modes in generated code
* A track record of finishing things: shipping, then fixing, then measuring impact

**Strong plus**

* Experience at a product company or on a high-scale system
* Performance, reliability or data-consistency work with measurable results
* Internal tools, automation, or agent-based workflows you've built
* Frontend or mobile exposure
* B.Tech/B.E. in CS, IT, ECE, EE or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program

**How You'll Be Evaluated**

1. **Resume and work review:**

2. **Practical coding round:**
   write, debug and test code under realistic constraints
3. **System design:**
   an open-ended design problem sized to a real scale
4. **AI-assisted build:**
   solve a task with an AI agent while we watch how you steer, verify and test
5. **Hiring manager conversation:**
   your hardest problems, failures, and what you learned

**Why Join**

* Real ownership and direct business impact from week one
* Exposure across stacks and domains
* Hands-on experience building with AI agents on production systems

**Apply Now!**

* Build a new product capability from an ambiguous requirement, making appropriate implementation and design decisions along the way.
* Investigate a slow or unreliable service, identify its bottlenecks, and improve its performance and resilience.
* Design a reliable workflow for processing tasks asynchronously, handling failures, and preventing data inconsistencies.
* Build an AI-powered workflow that uses external tools and APIs to automate a multi-step business process.
* Investigate a production failure in an unfamiliar codebase, identify the root cause, and ship a thoroughly tested fix.
* Develop an internal tool that removes repetitive manual work and measure the resulting improvement in efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

**Must Have**

* Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to reason systematically about unfamiliar problems.
* A solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, computational complexity, and essential software design principles.
* The ability to write clear, maintainable, and testable code, regardless of the programming language or technology used.
* A practical understanding of how software components interact, including APIs, databases, networking, and operating systems.
* The ability to break down complex tasks into smaller, verifiable steps and make progress without constant supervision.
* Comfort navigating unfamiliar codebases, learning new technologies, and adapting to different technical environments.
* A disciplined approach to debugging, testing, handling edge cases, and investigating the root causes of failures.
* The judgment to make reasonable technical trade-offs and recognize when a solution is unnecessarily complex or unreliable.
* Practical familiarity with AI coding tools or a demonstrated willingness to adopt them, along with the ability to validate generated code critically.
* Strong ownership, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias toward finishing and shipping work.
* The ability to communicate technical decisions clearly, ask useful questions, and take feedback constructively.
* Evidence of practical engineering ability through projects, internships, research, open-source contributions, or other work demonstrating problem-solving and implementation skills.

**Strong Plus**

* **B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science (CS), Information Technology (IT), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical Engineering (EE), or a related field, ideally from a strong engineering program.**
* Experience building and deploying software that solves a real problem for actual users.
* Experience diagnosing performance issues, improving reliability, or resolving difficult technical bugs.
* Exposure to production systems, cloud environments, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, or incident investigation.
* Experience working across multiple technical domains or adapting to unfamiliar technology stacks.
* Projects involving AI-powered applications, LLMs, autonomous agents, or workflow automation.
* Practical experience using AI coding agents to accelerate development while maintaining strong quality standards.
* Contributions to products, tools, research, or open-source projects that demonstrate initiative beyond completing tutorials.
* Evidence of independently taking an idea from initial problem discovery to a working, tested solution.

**How You'll Be Evaluated**

* **Engineering and project review:**
  Walk us through something you've built, the problem it solves, your personal contribution, and the decisions you made.
* **Practical problem-solving:**
  Work through an engineering problem that assesses reasoning, implementation, edge cases, and correctness rather than familiarity with a particular technology.
* **Code implementation and debugging:**
  Build or modify a solution in a practical environment, investigate failures, and demonstrate how you test your work.
* **System design and reasoning:**
  Approach an open-ended problem, explain the major components, evaluate trade-offs, and reason about reliability and future growth.
* **AI-assisted engineering exercise:**
  Use an AI agent to explore, build, or debug a solution while demonstrating how you guide, inspect, and verify its work.
* **Ownership and learning discussion:**
  Discuss a difficult problem you've solved, a mistake you've made, how you handled feedback, and how you approach unfamiliar technology.

**Why Join**

* Own meaningful engineering problems and contribute directly to product outcomes.
* Work across different technical domains rather than being restricted to a single technology stack.
* Learn how production systems are designed, built, deployed, monitored, and scaled.
* Use AI coding agents and modern engineering workflows to solve real-world problems.
* Develop strong engineering judgment through practical challenges, code reviews, and production ownership.
* Work in an environment that values initiative, learning speed, technical depth, and measurable impact.

**We value engineering ability over technology-stack familiarity, demonstrated problem-solving over memorized answers, and the ability to learn and deliver over experience with a specific tool.**

**Apply Now!**

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**About Us**
Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.
  
  
From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Grow a Career. Build a Future!**
Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
**The AI/ML Engineer – Data Scientist**
is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models, data pipelines, and intelligent AI agents that generate measurable business value across CNH Industrial. This role bridges classical data science with modern generative and agentic AI, enabling autonomous systems to plan, reason, and act on behalf of the business.
  
  
The role covers the full lifecycle of AI/ML solutions: from problem framing and data exploration, through model development and MLOps, to the design of multi-step AI agents that integrate with enterprise systems and execute complex tasks with minimal human intervention.
  
  
Leveraging a strong foundation in both statistics and software engineering, the senior holder of this role brings the maturity to mentor junior colleagues, contribute to the AI Center of Excellence, and drive responsible AI adoption aligned with CNH’s digital transformation strategy.
  
  
Collaboration happens within Agile/DevOps frameworks, using industry-leading MLOps tooling and cloud platforms.
  
  
Delivering production ML models for forecasting and optimization will directly reduce inventory costs and improve Supply Chain efficiency across AG and CE segments.
  
  
Agentic AI workflows will automate complex, multi-step manual processes, compressing cycle times and freeing human capacity for higher-value work.
  
  
Responsible, well-documented AI solutions will strengthen CNH’s data governance posture and accelerate enterprise adoption of AI at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end ML/AI solutions for key business use cases including demand forecasting, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, NLP, and process optimization.
* Develop and maintain robust data pipelines for feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and production inference, using platforms such as Databricks and Azure ML.
* Design and implement agentic AI systems: autonomous agents capable of multi-step reasoning, tool use, memory, and goal-directed behavior using frameworks such as the Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent.
* Integrate AI agents with enterprise tools, databases, APIs, and services via MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, function calling, and REST interfaces – enabling agents to take real actions within business workflows.
* Apply MLOps best practices: model versioning and registry (MLflow), CI/CD for ML pipelines, drift detection, A/B testing, and performance monitoring in production.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to frame problems, define success metrics, and translate requirements into scalable AI/data solutions.
* Ensure responsible AI: model explainability, fairness and bias auditing, data privacy compliance, and alignment with CNH governance standards.
* Conduct code and model reviews; contribute to shared libraries, best practices, and the CNH AI Center of Excellence.
* Maintain comprehensive technical documentation including data dictionaries, model cards, agent architecture diagrams, and operational runbooks.

**Experience Required**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in data science, machine learning, or AI engineering in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong proficiency in Python: pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras
* Proven experience building, validating, and deploying ML models to production (batch and real-time inference)
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred, or AWS / GCP) and managed ML services (Azure ML, SageMaker, Vertex AI)
* Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, or similar)
* Practical experience building AI agents or agentic workflows using frameworks such as Copilot Studio, AI Foundry, Claude Agent SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent – including tool use, memory management, and multi-step planning
* Knowledge of MLOps practices: experiment tracking (MLflow), model monitoring, CI/CD for ML, data and concept drift detection
* Experience with SQL and big data / cloud warehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, or similar)
* Experience in at least one industry SDLC tool (Jira / Azure DevOps), source code management (Git), and CI/CD pipelines
* Strong understanding of statistical methods, data structures, and algorithmic thinking
* Ability to translate business problems into data science formulations and communicate results to non-technical audiences
* A quality and responsibility mindset:
* Write clean, modular, well-documented, and testable code
* Value data accuracy, model transparency, and reproducibility
* Communicate proactively and collaborate across functions
* The ability to coach and mentor others
* Strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills (team player)
* Professional proficiency in English (verbal and written)
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) server development for agent tool integration
* Knowledge of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), vector databases, and embedding pipelines
* Experience with multi-agent orchestration and human-in-the-loop frameworks
* Familiarity with responsible AI
* Manufacturing, agriculture, or industrial domain knowledge
* Experience with graph databases or knowledge graphs for AI reasoning

**Preferred Qualifications**
B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
  
  
**What We Offer**
At CNH, our people are at the heart of everything we do. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits program designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success. From competitive compensation to flexible work arrangements and opportunities for continuous development, our benefits reflect our commitment to creating an environment where employees feel supported and empowered—both personally and professionally. We believe that when you’re given the tools to thrive, you can drive meaningful impact. At CNH, you’ll not only find the resources to succeed today—you’ll find the foundation to grow a career and build a future.

* Day-to-day, act as a technical expert, building and deploying production-grade ML and AI systems while championing engineering best practices across the team

title: Global AI/ML Engineer Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Manager – GenAI Engineering to lead the engineering, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and AI products within BCG's Internal People function and will play a critical role in driving the technical strategy, engineering delivery from build, QA to production and global adoption of AI/GenAI capabilities for various BCG's internal digital products that supports HR/People processes.
  
  
The Senior Manager will lead a multidisciplinary team of GenAI engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists while remaining hands-on in architecture, solution design, Python development, technical reviews, and production engineering.
  
  
The role requires a combination of deep GenAI technical expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, product thinking, delivery leadership, and the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Senior Manager – GenAI Engineering**
to lead the engineering, architecture, and delivery of enterprise-grade Generative AI and AI products within BCG's Internal People function and will play a critical role in driving the technical strategy, engineering delivery from build, QA to production and global adoption of AI/GenAI capabilities for various BCG's internal digital products that supports HR/People processes.
  
  
The Senior Manager will lead a multidisciplinary team of GenAI engineers, ML engineers, and data scientists while remaining hands-on in architecture, solution design, Python development, technical reviews, and production engineering.
  
  
The role requires a combination of deep GenAI technical expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, product thinking, delivery leadership, and the ability to influence senior technical and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Product & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Partner closely with product owners, functional leaders, and stakeholders within the People function to define requirements, shape backlog items, and translate business problems into technical solutions.
* Work with global and local market teams during rollouts to understand adoption, identify gaps, and continuously improve the solution.
* Partner with enterprise teams across architecture, security, Responsible AI etc. to seek approvals for the AI solutions during deployments and rollouts
* Communicate clearly and effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ensure GenAI solutions are designed and delivered in accordance with Responsible AI, security, privacy, data governance, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish appropriate AI guardrails covering areas such as prompt injection, data leakage, unauthorized tool access, unsafe outputs, and inappropriate model behaviour.
* Partner with Responsible AI, Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, and Enterprise Architecture teams to obtain necessary approvals and establish production-readiness standards.
* Ensure appropriate documentation of AI system architecture, model usage, data flows, risks, evaluations, and operational controls.
* Embed responsible AI and security considerations throughout the product lifecycle rather than treating them as post-development activities.

**GenAI Architecture & Technical Strategy**

* Define the technical vision, architecture, and engineering strategy for enterprise GenAI products.
* Design and guide implementation of LLM-powered applications, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, LLM orchestration, tool/function calling, and AI-powered decision-support solutions.
* Evaluate and select appropriate foundation models, embedding models, AI platforms, retrieval technologies, orchestration frameworks, and cloud services based on business and technical requirements.
* Establish reusable GenAI architecture patterns, reference architectures, engineering standards, and technical accelerators across the AI CoE.
* Make pragmatic build-vs-buy, model-selection, and platform decisions considering quality, scalability, security, latency, and cost.
* Conduct architecture and design reviews and provide technical direction across multiple engineering teams and workstreams.

**AI Evaluation & Quality**

* Define evaluation frameworks for GenAI applications covering accuracy, relevance, groundedness, hallucination, safety, robustness, latency, and cost.
* Establish automated evaluation and regression-testing strategies for models, prompts, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows.
* Partner with Product and business stakeholders to define AI quality and product success metrics.

**LLMOps / MLOps & Production Engineering**

* Establish production-grade LLMOps/MLOps practices covering model and prompt versioning, deployment, monitoring, observability, and continuous improvement.
* Define operational metrics covering AI quality, latency, reliability, usage, and cost.
* Establish CI/CD and automated testing practices for GenAI applications, prompts, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows.
* Design AI systems for scalability, availability, reliability, latency, and cost efficiency.

**Delivery & Team Leadership**

* Lead and coach a team of GenAI/ML engineers and data scientists delivering enterprise AI solutions end to end—from problem definition and design through development, deployment, and rollout.
* Own execution and delivery: planning, prioritization, agile ceremonies, timelines, and quality of outcomes.
* Provide technical direction, unblock teams, and ensure pragmatic, scalable solutions aligned with business needs.

**Hands-on Technical & Full-Stack Engineering**

* Remain hands-on in full-stack development, solution design, code reviews, and technical architecture.
* Guide development of production-grade GenAI-enabled applications across the frontend, backend, AI/ML, and data layers.
* Design and develop scalable backend services, REST APIs, microservices, and integrations required to support AI-powered products.
* Guide development of modern frontend applications and user experiences that integrate GenAI capabilities into enterprise workflows.
* Work effectively across frontend technologies such as React/TypeScript or equivalent frameworks, and backend technologies such as Python/Java or equivalent technologies.
* Guide integration of LLMs, AI agents, enterprise APIs, business systems, and data platforms into end-to-end product experiences.
* Remain hands-on in Python-based GenAI/ML development while providing technical direction across the broader application stack.
* Work effectively with modern cloud-native development stacks, including GitHub-based workflows, containers/Kubernetes, Airflow, CI/CD, observability, and data pipelines.
* Promote modern software engineering practices across full-stack, AI, and ML development.
* Remain hands-on in Python-based development, code reviews, and solution design.
* Guide development of GenAI-enabled features and applied ML solutions in a product context.
* Work effectively with modern cloud-native development stacks (e.g., GitHub-based workflows, Airflow, containerized/Kubernetes-based deployments, data pipelines).
* Promote modern software engineering practices across AI/ML development.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, ML/AI engineering, or data science, including significant experience designing and delivering production-grade GenAI/AI products and leading engineering teams.
* Hands on engineering development expertise to build and deploy production grade digital products.
* Demonstrated ability to lead delivery teams and grow into broader leadership responsibilities.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a pragmatic, outcomes-oriented approach.
* Proven experience leading teams of data scientists, ML engineers, or GenAI engineers delivering enterprise AI or digital products for internal or commercial products.
* Strong delivery and execution mindset, with experience owning timelines, dependencies, and outcomes.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage product owners, functional leaders, and senior stakeholders.
* Strong hands-on experience with: Python /Applied AI / ML / GenAI in production environments
* Cloud-based development and deployment environments
* Data pipelines and production-grade systems
* Ability to identify the right technical approach to solve business problems and guide teams accordingly.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will work closely with the People function & AI CoE leadership, Team Builder Product Owner, Tech owner, AI engineers, data scientists and stakeholders across the People function. You’ll partner with product functional and technical teams to ensure successful delivery and global adoption of AI solutions.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
*At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.*
*For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.*
*We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.*

* Experience developing LLM-based applications, including: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG); Insight generation and summarization; Conversational interface

In this role, you will bridge the gap between our core AI platform capabilities and the highly regulated, complex workflows of our enterprise clients (specifically across FinTech, Financial Services, and Enterprise SaaS).

Context-Aware RAG Pipelines: Build and optimize domain-specific Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector database architectures that ingest massive, disparate financial data sources (e.g., SEC filings, transaction ledgers, legacy ERP schemas) to feed localized AI agents.

The role combines delivery governance, commercial ownership, stakeholder leadership, and hands-on architecture oversight to translate business priorities into secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective data solutions.

Our diverse community of colleagues are all unified by a shared desire to make a difference in education.
  
  
Turnitin is a global organization with team members in over 35 countries including the United States, Mexico, United Kingdom, Australia, Japan, India, and the Philippines.
  
  
  
**Job Description**
  
The AI Specialist, Revenue Operations is responsible for building and running the AI workloads that support the global revenue organization. Revenue Operations is establishing an AI orchestration platform alongside a set of AI agents and automations that change how commercial teams work, and this role is the first dedicated build resource within it.
  
  
The primary focus is twofold. The role develops automations and agent features against a defined specification, and it owns the operational work that keeps live AI systems healthy and measurably effective: evaluation, knowledge curation, monitoring and first-line diagnosis. Technical direction and platform architecture are set by the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
  
  
This role also assists in establishing the working practices that Revenue Operations will follow. The standards this role helps set around documentation, evaluation and production readiness will determine how quickly our AI platforms can scale, and how much of the technical work can be safely devolved over time.
  
  
**Core areas of impact include:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Building AI agents, automations and integrations against a defined specification.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Establishing and running the evaluation that evidences AI agent performance.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Maintaining the knowledge bases and data that grounded AI agents depend on.
* **Operational Support:**
  Monitoring live AI workloads and owning first-line diagnosis of failures.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supporting the movement of AI workloads through technical and security review into production.

**Responsibilities:**

* **Workload Development:**
  Builds automations and AI agent features against a written specification and within the platform's established patterns, including prompt development, retrieval and knowledge grounding.
* **Quality Evaluation:**
  Authors and runs evaluation test cases for AI workloads, extends coverage as those workloads change, and produces the reporting that evidences whether agent performance is improving.
* **Knowledge Curation:**
  Curates and maintains the knowledge bases, content and data that grounded AI agents depend on, and prepares and transforms data for agent consumption.
* **Workload Operations:**
  Monitors live AI workloads, owns first-line investigation of failures, resolves issues within scope, and escalates the remainder with a clear technical diagnosis.
* **Integration Development:**
  Builds and maintains integrations with Revenue Operations systems through APIs and workflow orchestration tooling, with due attention to authentication, error handling and access control.
* **Production Readiness:**
  Supports the movement of AI workloads into production by assembling technical documentation, completing security and access reviews, and preparing release and rollback notes.
* **Technical Documentation:**
  Maintains accurate documentation for all AI workloads, and documents reusable patterns so that each successive build is faster to deliver than the last.
* **Platform Contribution:**
  Contributes to the ongoing development of an AI orchestration platform under the technical direction of the Senior Director, Revenue Enablement & AI Transformation.
* **Stakeholder Communication:**
  Explains the behavior and limitations of AI workloads clearly to non-technical colleagues across Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and the wider revenue organization.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Gathers feedback from users of live AI workloads and applies it to improve agent quality and reliability.

  
  
**Qualifications**
  
**Proven Characteristics for Success**

* Demonstrated ability to build working software with AI tooling, evidenced by delivered work rather than formal training alone.
* Strong diagnostic instinct and the persistence to establish why a system behaved as it did.
* Comfortable working to a defined technical direction while taking full ownership of implementation.
* Surfaces ambiguity in a specification rather than proceeding on assumption.
* Data-driven approach to quality, focused on measurement rather than assertion.
* Disciplined about documentation, with an understanding of why it matters to a small technical team.
* Highly organized with an action-oriented mindset and strong written communication skills.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Knowledge / Experience**
**Essential**

* Hands-on experience building with large language model APIs, including prompt engineering and retrieval or knowledge base systems. Self-directed and personal project work is considered.
* Working knowledge of Python or JavaScript, sufficient to read, modify and extend an existing codebase confidently.
* Practical experience integrating with REST APIs, including authentication and handling failure conditions in systems outside the developer's control.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data structures.
* Excellent written communication, particularly in documenting technical findings for a mixed audience.
* Legal eligibility for authorized employment within the India region.
* Fluent in verbal and written English.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a workflow automation or orchestration platform such as n8n, Make or Zapier.
* Technical exposure to a CRM or sales engagement platform, such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Experience in software testing, quality assurance or the evaluation of AI systems.
* Experience in technical support, troubleshooting or incident diagnosis.
* Experience with knowledge management, content curation or technical documentation.
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, particularly AWS.
* Experience with conversational or voice AI platforms.
* Knowledge and experience working within the EdTech sector.

**Education**

* Educated to degree level in a technical discipline or equivalent demonstrable experience. Candidates with a portfolio of self-taught, built work are encouraged to apply.

**Tii Elements**

* **Curiosity:**
  Has a growth mindset and leads with questions vs. assumptions. Unleashes creativity and possibility by actively seeking new experiences, information, and knowledge; embraces challenge, takes risks, learns fast and welcomes change.
* **Resourcefulness:**
  Possesses a mindset of abundance and redefines what's possible; creates and advances ways of achieving results in new or difficult situations either by appropriating additional resources, or by doing more with less.
* **Quality Focus:**
  Setting high quality standards for our work and striving for continuous improvement and quality assurance so that our internal & external customers get the best possible outcomes.
* **Self-Awareness & Impact:**
  Shows awareness of the impacts of one's choices, words, decisions and actions on others and on the business. And aligns behaviors with intended outcomes.

  
  
**Additional Information**
  
**Total Rewards @ Turnitin**
  
At Turnitin, we believe Total Rewards go far beyond pay. While salary, bonus, or commission are important, they’re only part of the value you receive in exchange for your work.
  
  
Beyond compensation, you’ll experience the intrinsic rewards of unleashing your potential and making a positive impact on global education. You’ll also thrive in a culture free of politics, surrounded by humble, inclusive, and collaborative teammates.
  
  
In addition, our extrinsic rewards include generous time off and health and wellness programs that provide choice, flexibility, and a safety net for life’s challenges. You’ll also enjoy a remote-first culture that empowers you to work with purpose and accountability in the way that suits you best, all supported by a comprehensive package that prioritizes your overall well-being.

underpin everything we do.

title: Software Development Engineer -1
description:
**About Mechademy**

Mechademy is transforming the predictive analytics landscape for rotating machinery. Our flagship platform, Turbomechanica, seamlessly integrates applied physics with advanced machine learning to deliver prescriptive insights. Turbomechanica detects potential issues long before they become costly failures, enabling clients to maximize uptime, extend asset life, and reduce operational risks. By empowering clients with optimized performance and reliability of their multi-billion-dollar assets, we’re setting a new standard for operational excellence.

**What We’re Looking For**

People who would rather build than talk about building. You’ll fit right in if you:

* Like owning a problem end to end, from the first design note to production.
* Pick up new tools quickly, and have opinions about which ones we should use.
* Care about getting things right, because engineers make real decisions on what we build.
* Enjoy a small, energetic team that ships fast and celebrates its wins.

**Why Mechademy?**

Kickstart your career with a company that’s fun, innovative, and shaping the future of the oil and gas industry. Mechademy is where cutting-edge predictive analytics meets a culture of collaboration and creativity. We’re not your typical start-up company – we thrive on solving complex challenges with technology, fostering growth, and making an impact. Whether you're diving into groundbreaking projects, learning from industry leaders, or enjoying team outings, you’ll feel valued and inspired every step of the way.

•
**Work on groundbreaking technology**
that is shaping the future of rotating equipment diagnostics.

•
**Relish a challenging, dynamic role**
with opportunities for individual contributions that direct impact on the success of the company.

•
**Grow into a leadership position**
as Mechademy grows.

•
**Enjoy flexible work hours**
to work when you are most efficient.

•
**Generous compensation**
to help you achieve financial stability.

At Mechademy, your ideas matter, your growth is our priority, and your future starts now.

**About the Role**

An unplanned trip of a single critical machine can halt production at an entire facility. Turbomechanica exists to see that coming, and the team makes sure the right people see it, trust it and act on it in time. You do not need an industrial or mechanical background. Our domain engineers will teach you how turbines and compressors fail.

**Responsibilities**

* **Platform -**
  Design, build and own features on a secure, multi-tenant platform used by enterprise clients across the globe. Work on authentication, access control and auditability, web and mobile experiences, and APIs that let other systems work with platform data safely.
* **Monitoring -**
  Build the workflows that turn detected issues into alerts, escalations and tracked actions, and the tooling that helps engineers prioritise, investigate and resolve issues faster. Work with large volumes of time series sensor data.
* **Reliability -**
  Add alerting, health checks and dashboards so we catch problems before a client does.
* **Engineering Quality -**
  Write clean, tested code and own features from design through production. Write design notes, take part in design and code reviews, and document what you build.
* **Ways of Working -**
  Ship in two-week sprints using Git, GitHub, CI/CD and ClickUp. Use modern developer tooling, including AI coding assistants, while staying accountable for every line you merge.

**Requirements**

**Must Have**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT, Electronics or a related branch
* 1.5+ years building and shipping production software
* Strong Python (preferred), or Java, Go, TypeScript or similar; solid DSA and OOP fundamentals
* REST APIs with Django, FastAPI, Flask, Express or similar
* SQL and relational databases, preferably PostgreSQL
* JavaScript or TypeScript, React preferred
* Web authentication basics (sessions, tokens, OAuth) and secure coding
* Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD
* Clear communication and a real willingness to learn and take feedback
* LLM APIs (Claude and other leading models), Model Context Protocol (MCP), RAG and agent orchestration frameworks

**Good to Have**

* Open source work or side projects you can discuss in depth
* Interest or experience in applied machine learning or LLMs
* Multi-tenant SaaS systems
* Time series data or large datasets
* Mobile app development
* SSO / OIDC providers, role-based access control
* Docker, AWS or Azure in production; logging, monitoring and alerting tools
* Mentoring peers, writing clear design docs

**What This Role Offers**

* **Work that matters -**
  What you build runs in production every day at some of the world’s largest energy companies.
* **Hard, real problems -**
  Security, multi-tenancy, large-scale sensor data and systems engineers depend on.
* **Ownership -**
  A squad buddy gets you productive in 30 days; you own a part of the platform within 6 months.
* **Mentorship -**
  Learn from senior engineers and domain experts with decades of equipment experience.
* **Growth -**
  A clear path from SDE-1 to SDE-2.
* **Flexibility -**
  Flexible work hours and a hybrid setup.

**Selection Process**

1. Introductory call - A short conversation with our talent team about your background, interests and expectations.
2. Technical interview 1 - Problem solving and live coding, plus a deep dive into a project you have shipped.
3. Technical interview 2 - System design and full stack fundamentals: APIs, data modelling, scaling and trade-offs.
4. Hiring manager - A conversation with the P&M Squad Owner about how you work, own problems and grow.
5. HR and culture - Team fit, compensation and joining logistics.

*No trick puzzles. When you apply, tell us about something you have shipped. That matters more to us than where you have worked.*

title: Decision Analyst
description:
**Function: Data Analytics, Decision Science & Business Strategy**
**Role Overview**
We are looking for an experienced analytics professional to extract meaningful insights from complex datasets, develop robust quantitative models, and deliver actionable recommendations to support strategic business decisions. The role involves working with multiple internal and external data sources, conducting scenario analysis, monitoring model performance, and implementing data quality and governance controls.
  
  
The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, influence business decisions, manage complex analytical assignments, and contribute to operational effectiveness, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Analysis & Insights: Identify, extract, and analyze relevant data from multiple internal and external sources to generate meaningful business insights.
* Quantitative Modelling: Develop, implement, and validate quantitative models to support decision-making across various business functions.
* Sensitivity Analysis & Scenario Planning: Conduct sensitivity analysis, forecasting, and scenario modelling to evaluate potential business outcomes and support strategic planning.
* Model Performance & Validation: Monitor existing models, assess their effectiveness, identify performance gaps, and recommend improvements.
* Data Quality & Governance: Establish and implement data quality checks, validation procedures, and control mechanisms to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
* Business Decision Support: Translate complex analytical findings into actionable recommendations for senior stakeholders and business leaders.
* Risk Management & Controls: Identify potential risks, strengthen control frameworks, and contribute to the development of policies and procedures supporting governance and compliance.
* Stakeholder Management: Collaborate with business units and specialist teams to address complex problems, align analytical outcomes with business objectives, and influence decision-making.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve analytical methodologies, operational processes, model effectiveness, and overall business performance.

Communication & Reporting: Present complex or sensitive information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences, including senior management.
  
  
**Leadership & Management Expectations**

* Lead complex analytical assignments and guide team members in delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Establish objectives, coach employees, evaluate performance, and support professional development where applicable.
* Provide expert advice on complex issues and support stakeholders in resolving escalated business challenges.
* Drive collaboration across business functions and identify opportunities to combine methodologies and specialist expertise.
* Promote accountability, operational excellence, effective risk management, and a strong control environment.
* For individual contributor roles, lead cross-functional projects, guide colleagues, and recommend new analytical approaches to achieve business outcomes.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong quantitative and analytical problem-solving skills.
* Experience in quantitative modelling, model validation, and performance monitoring.
* Ability to work with complex datasets from multiple sources.
* Knowledge of sensitivity analysis, scenario planning, and data quality management.
* Understanding of risk management, governance, and control frameworks.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex findings effectively.
* Experience leading projects, mentoring team members, or managing analytical teams, depending on the role structure.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to translate data-driven insights into practical recommendations.

**Key Success Factors**

* Deliver reliable, validated, and decision-oriented quantitative models.
* Improve data quality, analytical accuracy, and model performance.
* Provide actionable insights that support business strategy and operational effectiveness.
* Strengthen governance, risk management, and internal controls.
* Build effective cross-functional relationships and influence business outcomes.

title: Evidence Lead, AI Access Initiative (EAII Advisors)
description: About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.Agriculture: We have an ambitious goal to reach 100M+ farmers with AI-enabled weather forecasts, expand forecast R&D to generate novel forecasts, and build public and private sector (WhatsApp, telcos) delivery channels to deliver new, LLM-generated voice and image content that maximizes behavior change. Health: Here, our initial goal is to scale AI-enabled clinical decision support to 20M+ people via telemedicine platforms, dramatically improving diagnosis and health outcomes at a national level. We are also planning to explore and test novel interventions for low-resource settings, including direct-to-consumer (DTC) health interventions. We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.About 2AI India And EAII AdvisorsEAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.2AI India is being incubated as a project within EAII Advisors, with plans to spin off into an independent entity at the end of this year. We are hiring a founding team: the first hires will shape the culture, establish the operating model, and own early wins before the organization scales.Roles And ResponsibilitiesThe Evidence Lead is 2AI India's primary engine for measuring whether our programs work and why. This is not a traditional monitoring and evaluation (M&E) role. The focus is generating insights that change program design in real time. Data collection for government reporting is a real but secondary function, roughly 20% of the role. title: Expert Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
**About Bain AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS)**
Bain’s AI, Insights & Solutions (AIS) team works with clients to design and deliver AI-powered solutions that create measurable business impact. You’ll operate in multidisciplinary teams alongside Bain consultants, other experts in product, design, architecture and engineering, and client stakeholders, translating ambiguous business problems into robust AI applications that can be piloted, scaled, and adopted.
  
  
**The Impact You’ll Have**
Bain works with clients on board-level and executive priorities, helping deliver step-change results across growth, productivity, and resilience. In that context, AI is rarely a point solution. The most meaningful outcomes come from building AI as part of an integrated system that combines technology with redesigned processes, operating model changes, and adoption at scale across the organization.
  
  
As an AI Engineering leader in AIS, you will support the building of the technical core within these transformations and work as part of broader Bain consulting teams to move solutions from prototype to real adoption. The result is measurable impact at the company or enterprise level and, in many cases, helps clients set new performance standards for their industries.
  
  
**The Role**
The Expert Senior Manager AI Engineer will architect, build, and scale next-generation generative AI systems and agentic solutions for Bain’s clients. As a leader in the practice, you will sit at the intersection of advanced engineering, applied AI research, product strategy, and responsible AI governance. You will own the full lifecycle — from research and experimentation to production deployment and ongoing optimization — and guide teams across engineering, product, data science, ethics, and client stakeholders.
  
  
You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.
  
  
Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn while doing, with support from other experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end generative AI systems, including multi-agent workflows and production-grade AI applications.
* Architect multi-component pipelines, including:

+ Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
+ Fine-tuning and parameter-efficient tuning
+ Embedding generation and optimization
+ Hybrid retrieval strategies (vector, graph, keyword)

* Integrate reasoning, tool use, function calling, and orchestration across complex workflows
* Engineer advanced agentic systems, ensuring clear separation of concerns, robust memory architecture, and scalable tool ecosystems
* Lead everything from early-stage research, model experimentation, and evaluation design to production system deployment
* Oversee API development, microservices, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and cloud-native deployment
* Build scalable GenAIOps processes for automated testing, regression evaluation, latency monitoring, and continual improvement
* Balance performance, safety, responsible AI principles, and cost across system design:

+ Implement guardrails, fallbacks, red-teaming strategies, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) workflows
+ Partner with global ethics teams to ensure alignment with Bain’s Responsible AI standards

* Build automated evaluation suites integrating user signals, continual learning cycles, and ongoing model updates
* Design and implement evaluation frameworks covering:

+ Hallucination rate and factual consistency
+ Relevance and precision/recall
+ Latency, throughput, and system-level performance
+ Cost tracking and efficiency

* Partner closely with product, engineering, data science, ethics, and infrastructure teams to build robust, compliant AI systems
* Act as a thought partner to executives and clients on AI strategy, architecture decisions, emerging capabilities, and implementation roadmaps
* Mentor and upskill technical teams on best practices including RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and AI safety

**What We’re Looking For**

* 8–12+ years in software engineering, ML engineering, or applied AI roles with significant hands-on building responsibilities
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stack generative AI programs from conception through production
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate highly technical concepts to business stakeholders
* Track record of leading engineering teams, mentoring technical talent, and collaborating with diverse cross-functional groups
* Advanced prompt engineering, context engineering, and conversation design
* Strong expertise in evaluation design, experimentation frameworks, and data labeling strategies for LLM apps
* Deep experience with:
* Advanced RAG architectures (vector, hybrid, graph-based retrieval)
* Agentic architectures (multi-agent systems, tool selection, routing, memory, planning, reflection)
* ReAct, RLAIF, and other HITL + feedback loops.
* AI-Specific Tools & Frameworks - Orchestration frameworks, Vector and graph databases and Model + API ecosystems
* Strong background in system design, architecture, and production-grade deployment
* Deep familiarity with cost optimization and computational tradeoffs for LLM workloads
* Comfort operating in high-ambiguity environments with collaborative cross-functional teams
* Clear ability to lead, mentor, and inspire technical teams
* Experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise transformation environments is a strong plus

**Working Model & Travel**

* This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.
* Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.
